105static int vmap_pte_range(pmd_t *pmd, unsigned long addr, unsigned long end,
106 phys_addr_t phys_addr, pgprot_t prot,
107 unsigned int max_page_shift, pgtbl_mod_mask *mask)
108{
109 pte_t *pte;
110 u64 pfn;
111 struct page *page;
112 unsigned long size = PAGE_SIZE;
113
114 if (WARN_ON_ONCE(!PAGE_ALIGNED(end - addr)))
115 return -EINVAL;
116
117 pfn = phys_addr >> PAGE_SHIFT;
118 pte = pte_alloc_kernel_track(pmd, addr, mask);
119 if (!pte)
120 return -ENOMEM;
121
122 lazy_mmu_mode_enable();
123
124 do {
125 if (unlikely(!pte_none(ptep_get(pte)))) {
126 if (pfn_valid(pfn)) {
127 page = pfn_to_page(pfn);
128 dump_page(page, "remapping already mapped page");
129 }
130 BUG();
131 }
132
133#ifdef CONFIG_HUGETLB_PAGE
134 size = arch_vmap_pte_range_map_size(addr, end, pfn, max_page_shift);
135 if (size != PAGE_SIZE) {
136 pte_t entry = pfn_pte(pfn, prot);
137
138 entry = arch_make_huge_pte(entry, ilog2(size), 0);
139 set_huge_pte_at(&init_mm, addr, pte, entry, size);
140 pfn += PFN_DOWN(size);
141 continue;
142 }
143#endif
144 set_pte_at(&init_mm, addr, pte, pfn_pte(pfn, prot));
145 pfn++;
146 } while (pte += PFN_DOWN(size), addr += size, addr != end);
147
148 lazy_mmu_mode_disable();
149 *mask |= PGTBL_PTE_MODIFIED;
150 return 0;
151}

156static int vmap_try_huge_pmd(pmd_t *pmd, unsigned long addr, unsigned long end,
157 phys_addr_t phys_addr, pgprot_t prot,
158 unsigned int max_page_shift)
159{
160 if (max_page_shift < PMD_SHIFT)
161 return 0;
162
163 if (!arch_vmap_pmd_supported(prot))
164 return 0;
165
166 if ((end - addr) != PMD_SIZE)
167 return 0;
168
169 if (!IS_ALIGNED(addr, PMD_SIZE))
170 return 0;
171
172 if (!IS_ALIGNED(phys_addr, PMD_SIZE))
173 return 0;
174
175 if (pmd_present(*pmd) && !pmd_free_pte_page(pmd, addr))
176 return 0;
177
178 return pmd_set_huge(pmd, phys_addr, prot);
179}
180
184static int vmap_pmd_range(pud_t *pud, unsigned long addr, unsigned long end,
185 phys_addr_t phys_addr, pgprot_t prot,
186 unsigned int max_page_shift, pgtbl_mod_mask *mask)
187{
188 pmd_t *pmd;
189 unsigned long next;
190 int err = 0;
191
192 pmd = pmd_alloc_track(&init_mm, pud, addr, mask);
193 if (!pmd)
194 return -ENOMEM;
195 do {
196 next = pmd_addr_end(addr, end);
197
198 if (vmap_try_huge_pmd(pmd, addr, next, phys_addr, prot,
199 max_page_shift)) {
200 *mask |= PGTBL_PMD_MODIFIED;
201 continue;
202 }
203
204 err = vmap_pte_range(pmd, addr, next, phys_addr, prot, max_page_shift, mask);
205 if (err)
206 break;
207 } while (pmd++, phys_addr += (next - addr), addr = next, addr != end);
208 return err;
209}

330static int vmap_range_noflush(unsigned long addr, unsigned long end,
331 phys_addr_t phys_addr, pgprot_t prot,
332 unsigned int max_page_shift)
333{
334 pgd_t *pgd;
335 unsigned long start;
336 unsigned long next;
337 int err;
338 pgtbl_mod_mask mask = 0;
339
340 /*
341 * Might allocate pagetables (for most archs a more precise annotation
342 * would be might_alloc(GFP_PGTABLE_KERNEL)). Also might shootdown TLB
343 * (requires IRQs enabled on x86).
344 */
345 might_sleep();
346 BUG_ON(addr >= end);
347
348 start = addr;
349 pgd = pgd_offset_k(addr);
350 do {
351 next = pgd_addr_end(addr, end);
352 err = vmap_p4d_range(pgd, addr, next, phys_addr, prot,
353 max_page_shift, &mask);
354 if (err)
355 break;
356 } while (pgd++, phys_addr += (next - addr), addr = next, addr != end);
357
358 if (mask & ARCH_PAGE_TABLE_SYNC_MASK)
359 arch_sync_kernel_mappings(start, end);
360
361 return err;
362}

367int vmap_page_range(unsigned long addr, unsigned long end,
368 phys_addr_t phys_addr, pgprot_t prot)
369{
370 int err;
371
372 err = vmap_range_noflush(addr, end, phys_addr, pgprot_nx(prot),
373 ioremap_max_page_shift);
374 flush_cache_vmap(addr, end);
375 if (!err)
376 err = kmsan_ioremap_page_range(addr, end, phys_addr, prot,
377 ioremap_max_page_shift);
378 return err;
379}

384int ioremap_page_range(unsigned long addr, unsigned long end,
385 phys_addr_t phys_addr, pgprot_t prot)
386{
387 struct vm_struct *area;
388
389 area = find_vm_area((void *)addr);
390 if (!area || !(area->flags & VM_IOREMAP)) {
391 WARN_ONCE(1, "vm_area at addr %lx is not marked as VM_IOREMAP\n", addr);
392 return -EINVAL;
393 }
394 if (addr != (unsigned long)area->addr ||
395 (void *)end != area->addr + get_vm_area_size(area)) {
396 WARN_ONCE(1, "ioremap request [%lx,%lx) doesn't match vm_area [%lx, %lx)\n",
397 addr, end, (long)area->addr,
398 (long)area->addr + get_vm_area_size(area));
399 return -ERANGE;
400 }
401 return vmap_page_range(addr, end, phys_addr, prot);
402}

407static void vunmap_pte_range(pmd_t *pmd, unsigned long addr, unsigned long end,
408 pgtbl_mod_mask *mask)
409{
410 pte_t *pte;
411 pte_t ptent;
412 unsigned long size = PAGE_SIZE;
413
414 pte = pte_offset_kernel(pmd, addr);
415 lazy_mmu_mode_enable();
416
417 do {
418#ifdef CONFIG_HUGETLB_PAGE
419 size = arch_vmap_pte_range_unmap_size(addr, pte);
420 if (size != PAGE_SIZE) {
421 if (WARN_ON(!IS_ALIGNED(addr, size))) {
422 addr = ALIGN_DOWN(addr, size);
423 pte = PTR_ALIGN_DOWN(pte, sizeof(*pte) * (size >> PAGE_SHIFT));
424 }
425 ptent = huge_ptep_get_and_clear(&init_mm, addr, pte, size);
426 if (WARN_ON(end - addr < size))
427 size = end - addr;
428 } else
429#endif
430 ptent = ptep_get_and_clear(&init_mm, addr, pte);
431 WARN_ON(!pte_none(ptent) && !pte_present(ptent));
432 } while (pte += (size >> PAGE_SHIFT), addr += size, addr != end);
433
434 lazy_mmu_mode_disable();
435 *mask |= PGTBL_PTE_MODIFIED;
436}
437
441static void vunmap_pmd_range(pud_t *pud, unsigned long addr, unsigned long end,
442 pgtbl_mod_mask *mask)
443{
444 pmd_t *pmd;
445 unsigned long next;
446 int cleared;
447
448 pmd = pmd_offset(pud, addr);
449 do {
450 next = pmd_addr_end(addr, end);
451
452 cleared = pmd_clear_huge(pmd);
453 if (cleared || pmd_bad(*pmd))
454 *mask |= PGTBL_PMD_MODIFIED;
455
456 if (cleared) {
457 WARN_ON(next - addr < PMD_SIZE);
458 continue;
459 }
460 if (pmd_none_or_clear_bad(pmd))
461 continue;
462 vunmap_pte_range(pmd, addr, next, mask);
463
464 cond_resched();
465 } while (pmd++, addr = next, addr != end);
466}

534void __vunmap_range_noflush(unsigned long start, unsigned long end)
535{
536 unsigned long next;
537 pgd_t *pgd;
538 unsigned long addr = start;
539 pgtbl_mod_mask mask = 0;
540
541 BUG_ON(addr >= end);
542 pgd = pgd_offset_k(addr);
543 do {
544 next = pgd_addr_end(addr, end);
545 if (pgd_bad(*pgd))
546 mask |= PGTBL_PGD_MODIFIED;
547 if (pgd_none_or_clear_bad(pgd))
548 continue;
549 vunmap_p4d_range(pgd, addr, next, &mask);
550 } while (pgd++, addr = next, addr != end);
551
552 if (mask & ARCH_PAGE_TABLE_SYNC_MASK)
553 arch_sync_kernel_mappings(start, end);
554}

587static int vmap_pages_pte_range(pmd_t *pmd, unsigned long addr,
588 unsigned long end, pgprot_t prot, struct page **pages, int *nr,
589 pgtbl_mod_mask *mask)
590{
591 int err = 0;
592 pte_t *pte;
593
594 /*
595 * nr is a running index into the array which helps higher level
596 * callers keep track of where we're up to.
597 */
598
599 pte = pte_alloc_kernel_track(pmd, addr, mask);
600 if (!pte)
601 return -ENOMEM;
602
603 lazy_mmu_mode_enable();
604
605 do {
606 struct page *page = pages[*nr];
607
608 if (WARN_ON(!pte_none(ptep_get(pte)))) {
609 err = -EBUSY;
610 break;
611 }
612 if (WARN_ON(!page)) {
613 err = -ENOMEM;
614 break;
615 }
616 if (WARN_ON(!pfn_valid(page_to_pfn(page)))) {
617 err = -EINVAL;
618 break;
619 }
620
621 set_pte_at(&init_mm, addr, pte, mk_pte(page, prot));
622 (*nr)++;
623 } while (pte++, addr += PAGE_SIZE, addr != end);
624
625 lazy_mmu_mode_disable();
626 *mask |= PGTBL_PTE_MODIFIED;
627
628 return err;
629}

697static int vmap_small_pages_range_noflush(unsigned long addr, unsigned long end,
698 pgprot_t prot, struct page **pages)
699{
700 unsigned long start = addr;
701 pgd_t *pgd;
702 unsigned long next;
703 int err = 0;
704 int nr = 0;
705 pgtbl_mod_mask mask = 0;
706
707 BUG_ON(addr >= end);
708 pgd = pgd_offset_k(addr);
709 do {
710 next = pgd_addr_end(addr, end);
711 if (pgd_bad(*pgd))
712 mask |= PGTBL_PGD_MODIFIED;
713 err = vmap_pages_p4d_range(pgd, addr, next, prot, pages, &nr, &mask);
714 if (err)
715 break;
716 } while (pgd++, addr = next, addr != end);
717
718 if (mask & ARCH_PAGE_TABLE_SYNC_MASK)
719 arch_sync_kernel_mappings(start, end);
720
721 return err;
722}

736int __vmap_pages_range_noflush(unsigned long addr, unsigned long end,
737 pgprot_t prot, struct page **pages, unsigned int page_shift)
738{
739 unsigned int i, nr = (end - addr) >> PAGE_SHIFT;
740
741 WARN_ON(page_shift < PAGE_SHIFT);
742
743 if (!IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_HAVE_ARCH_HUGE_VMALLOC) ||
744 page_shift == PAGE_SHIFT)
745 return vmap_small_pages_range_noflush(addr, end, prot, pages);
746
747 for (i = 0; i < nr; i += 1U << (page_shift - PAGE_SHIFT)) {
748 int err;
749
750 err = vmap_range_noflush(addr, addr + (1UL << page_shift),
751 page_to_phys(pages[i]), prot,
752 page_shift);
753 if (err)
754 return err;
755
756 addr += 1UL << page_shift;
757 }
758
759 return 0;
760}

765int vmap_pages_range_noflush(unsigned long addr, unsigned long end,
766 pgprot_t prot, struct page **pages, unsigned int page_shift,
767 gfp_t gfp_mask)
768{
769 int ret = kmsan_vmap_pages_range_noflush(addr, end, prot, pages,
770 page_shift, gfp_mask);
771
772 if (ret)
773 return ret;
774 return __vmap_pages_range_noflush(addr, end, prot, pages, page_shift);
775}

815static int check_sparse_vm_area(struct vm_struct *area, unsigned long start,
816 unsigned long end)
817{
818 might_sleep();
819 if (WARN_ON_ONCE(area->flags & VM_FLUSH_RESET_PERMS))
820 return -EINVAL;
821 if (WARN_ON_ONCE(area->flags & VM_NO_GUARD))
822 return -EINVAL;
823 if (WARN_ON_ONCE(!(area->flags & VM_SPARSE)))
824 return -EINVAL;
825 if ((end - start) >> PAGE_SHIFT > totalram_pages())
826 return -E2BIG;
827 if (start < (unsigned long)area->addr ||
828 (void *)end > area->addr + get_vm_area_size(area))
829 return -ERANGE;
830 return 0;
831}
832
843int vm_area_map_pages(struct vm_struct *area, unsigned long start,
844 unsigned long end, struct page **pages)
845{
846 int err;
847
848 err = check_sparse_vm_area(area, start, end);
849 if (err)
850 return err;
851
852 return vmap_pages_range(start, end, PAGE_KERNEL, pages, PAGE_SHIFT);
853}
854
864void vm_area_unmap_pages(struct vm_struct *area, unsigned long start,
865 unsigned long end)
866{
867 if (check_sparse_vm_area(area, start, end))
868 return;
869
870 vunmap_range(start, end);
871}

876int is_vmalloc_or_module_addr(const void *x)
877{
878 /*
879 * ARM, x86-64 and sparc64 put modules in a special place,
880 * and fall back on vmalloc() if that fails. Others
881 * just put it in the vmalloc space.
882 */
883#if defined(CONFIG_EXECMEM) && defined(MODULES_VADDR)
884 unsigned long addr = (unsigned long)kasan_reset_tag(x);
885 if (addr >= MODULES_VADDR && addr < MODULES_END)
886 return 1;
887#endif
888 return is_vmalloc_addr(x);
889}
890EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL(is_vmalloc_or_module_addr);
891
900struct page *vmalloc_to_page(const void *vmalloc_addr)
901{
902 unsigned long addr = (unsigned long) vmalloc_addr;
903 struct page *page = NULL;
904 pgd_t *pgd = pgd_offset_k(addr);
905 p4d_t *p4d;
906 pud_t *pud;
907 pmd_t *pmd;
908 pte_t *ptep, pte;
909
910 /*
911 * XXX we might need to change this if we add VIRTUAL_BUG_ON for
912 * architectures that do not vmalloc module space
913 */
914 VIRTUAL_BUG_ON(!is_vmalloc_or_module_addr(vmalloc_addr));
915
916 if (pgd_none(*pgd))
917 return NULL;
918 if (WARN_ON_ONCE(pgd_leaf(*pgd)))
919 return NULL; /* XXX: no allowance for huge pgd */
920 if (WARN_ON_ONCE(pgd_bad(*pgd)))
921 return NULL;
922
923 p4d = p4d_offset(pgd, addr);
924 if (p4d_none(*p4d))
925 return NULL;
926 if (p4d_leaf(*p4d))
927 return p4d_page(*p4d) + ((addr & ~P4D_MASK) >> PAGE_SHIFT);
928 if (WARN_ON_ONCE(p4d_bad(*p4d)))
929 return NULL;
930
931 pud = pud_offset(p4d, addr);
932 if (pud_none(*pud))
933 return NULL;
934 if (pud_leaf(*pud))
935 return pud_page(*pud) + ((addr & ~PUD_MASK) >> PAGE_SHIFT);
936 if (WARN_ON_ONCE(pud_bad(*pud)))
937 return NULL;
938
939 pmd = pmd_offset(pud, addr);
940 if (pmd_none(*pmd))
941 return NULL;
942 if (pmd_leaf(*pmd))
943 return pmd_page(*pmd) + ((addr & ~PMD_MASK) >> PAGE_SHIFT);
944 if (WARN_ON_ONCE(pmd_bad(*pmd)))
945 return NULL;
946
947 ptep = pte_offset_kernel(pmd, addr);
948 pte = ptep_get(ptep);
949 if (pte_present(pte))
950 page = pte_page(pte);
951
952 return page;
953}
954EXPORT_SYMBOL(vmalloc_to_page);
955
962unsigned long vmalloc_to_pfn(const void *vmalloc_addr)
963{
964 return page_to_pfn(vmalloc_to_page(vmalloc_addr));
965}
966EXPORT_SYMBOL(vmalloc_to_pfn);

1072static struct vmap_node *vmap_nodes = &single;

1077#define for_each_vmap_node(vn) \
1078 for ((vn) = &vmap_nodes[0]; \
1079 (vn) < &vmap_nodes[nr_vmap_nodes]; (vn)++)
1080
1084static inline unsigned int
1085addr_to_node_id(unsigned long addr)
1086{
1087 return (addr / vmap_zone_size) % nr_vmap_nodes;

1093static inline struct vmap_node *
1094addr_to_node(unsigned long addr)
1095{

1103id_to_node(unsigned int id)
1104{

1111static inline unsigned int
1112node_to_id(struct vmap_node *node)
1113{
1114 /* Pointer arithmetic. */
1115 unsigned int id = node - vmap_nodes;
1116
1117 if (likely(id < nr_vmap_nodes))
1118 return id;
1119
1120 WARN_ONCE(1, "An address 0x%p is out-of-bounds.\n", node);
1121 return 0;
1122}
1123
1134static unsigned int
1135encode_vn_id(unsigned int node_id)
1136{
1137 /* Can store U8_MAX [0:254] nodes. */
1138 if (node_id < nr_vmap_nodes)
1139 return (node_id + 1) << BITS_PER_BYTE;
1140
1141 /* Warn and no node encoded. */
1142 WARN_ONCE(1, "Encode wrong node id (%u)\n", node_id);
1143 return 0;
1144}
1145
1154static unsigned int
1155decode_vn_id(unsigned int val)
1156{
1157 unsigned int node_id = (val >> BITS_PER_BYTE) - 1;
1158
1159 /* Can store U8_MAX [0:254] nodes. */
1160 if (node_id < nr_vmap_nodes)
1161 return node_id;
1162
1163 /* If it was _not_ zero, warn. */
1164 WARN_ONCE(node_id != UINT_MAX,
1165 "Decode wrong node id (%d)\n", node_id);
1166
1167 return nr_vmap_nodes;
1168}

1173static bool
1174is_vn_id_valid(unsigned int node_id)
1175{
1176 if (node_id < nr_vmap_nodes)
1177 return true;
1178
1179 return false;
1180}

1225static struct vmap_area *__find_vmap_area(unsigned long addr, struct rb_root *root)
1226{
1227 struct rb_node *n = root->rb_node;
1228
1229 addr = (unsigned long)kasan_reset_tag((void *)addr);
1230
1231 while (n) {
1232 struct vmap_area *va;
1233
1234 va = rb_entry(n, struct vmap_area, rb_node);
1235 if (addr < va->va_start)
1236 n = n->rb_left;
1237 else if (addr >= va->va_end)
1238 n = n->rb_right;
1239 else
1240 return va;
1241 }
1242
1243 return NULL;
1244}
1245
1251static struct vmap_area *
1252__find_vmap_area_exceed_addr(unsigned long addr, struct rb_root *root)
1253{
1254 struct vmap_area *va = NULL;
1255 struct rb_node *n = root->rb_node;
1256
1257 addr = (unsigned long)kasan_reset_tag((void *)addr);
1258
1259 while (n) {
1260 struct vmap_area *tmp;
1261
1262 tmp = rb_entry(n, struct vmap_area, rb_node);
1263 if (tmp->va_end > addr) {
1264 va = tmp;
1265 if (tmp->va_start <= addr)
1266 break;
1267
1268 n = n->rb_left;
1269 } else
1270 n = n->rb_right;
1271 }
1272
1273 return va;
1274}
1275
1286static struct vmap_node *
1287find_vmap_area_exceed_addr_lock(unsigned long addr, struct vmap_area **va)
1288{
1289 unsigned long va_start_lowest;
1290 struct vmap_node *vn;
1291
1292repeat:
1293 va_start_lowest = 0;
1294
1295 for_each_vmap_node(vn) {
1296 spin_lock(&vn->busy.lock);
1297 *va = __find_vmap_area_exceed_addr(addr, &vn->busy.root);
1298
1299 if (*va)
1300 if (!va_start_lowest || (*va)->va_start < va_start_lowest)
1301 va_start_lowest = (*va)->va_start;
1302 spin_unlock(&vn->busy.lock);
1303 }
1304
1305 /*
1306 * Check if found VA exists, it might have gone away. In this case we
1307 * repeat the search because a VA has been removed concurrently and we
1308 * need to proceed to the next one, which is a rare case.
1309 */
1310 if (va_start_lowest) {
1311 vn = addr_to_node(va_start_lowest);
1312
1313 spin_lock(&vn->busy.lock);
1314 *va = __find_vmap_area(va_start_lowest, &vn->busy.root);
1315
1316 if (*va)
1317 return vn;
1318
1319 spin_unlock(&vn->busy.lock);
1320 goto repeat;
1321 }
1322
1323 return NULL;
1324}
1325
1337static __always_inline struct rb_node **
1338find_va_links(struct vmap_area *va,
1339 struct rb_root *root, struct rb_node *from,
1340 struct rb_node **parent)
1341{
1342 struct vmap_area *tmp_va;
1343 struct rb_node **link;
1344
1345 if (root) {
1346 link = &root->rb_node;
1347 if (unlikely(!*link)) {
1348 *parent = NULL;
1349 return link;
1350 }
1351 } else {
1352 link = &from;
1353 }
1354
1355 /*
1356 * Go to the bottom of the tree. When we hit the last point
1357 * we end up with parent rb_node and correct direction, i name
1358 * it link, where the new va->rb_node will be attached to.
1359 */
1360 do {
1361 tmp_va = rb_entry(*link, struct vmap_area, rb_node);
1362
1363 /*
1364 * During the traversal we also do some sanity check.
1365 * Trigger the BUG() if there are sides(left/right)
1366 * or full overlaps.
1367 */
1368 if (va->va_end <= tmp_va->va_start)
1369 link = &(*link)->rb_left;
1370 else if (va->va_start >= tmp_va->va_end)
1371 link = &(*link)->rb_right;
1372 else {
1373 WARN(1, "vmalloc bug: 0x%lx-0x%lx overlaps with 0x%lx-0x%lx\n",
1374 va->va_start, va->va_end, tmp_va->va_start, tmp_va->va_end);
1375
1376 return NULL;
1377 }
1378 } while (*link);
1379
1380 *parent = &tmp_va->rb_node;
1381 return link;
1382}
1383
1387static __always_inline struct list_head *
1388get_va_next_sibling(struct rb_node *parent, struct rb_node **link)
1389{
1390 struct list_head *list;
1391
1392 if (unlikely(!parent))
1393 /*
1394 * The red-black tree where we try to find VA neighbors
1395 * before merging or inserting is empty, i.e. it means
1396 * there is no free vmap space. Normally it does not
1397 * happen but we handle this case anyway.
1398 */
1399 return NULL;
1400
1401 list = &rb_entry(parent, struct vmap_area, rb_node)->list;
1402 return (&parent->rb_right == link ? list->next : list);
1403}
1404
1408static __always_inline void
1409__link_va(struct vmap_area *va, struct rb_root *root,
1410 struct rb_node *parent, struct rb_node **link,
1411 struct list_head *head, bool augment)
1412{
1413 /*
1414 * VA is still not in the list, but we can
1415 * identify its future previous list_head node.
1416 */
1417 if (likely(parent)) {
1418 head = &rb_entry(parent, struct vmap_area, rb_node)->list;
1419 if (&parent->rb_right != link)
1420 head = head->prev;
1421 }
1422
1423 /* Insert to the rb-tree */
1424 rb_link_node(&va->rb_node, parent, link);
1425 if (augment) {
1426 /*
1427 * Some explanation here. Just perform simple insertion
1428 * to the tree. We do not set va->subtree_max_size to
1429 * its current size before calling rb_insert_augmented().
1430 * It is because we populate the tree from the bottom
1431 * to parent levels when the node _is_ in the tree.
1432 *
1433 * Therefore we set subtree_max_size to zero after insertion,
1434 * to let __augment_tree_propagate_from() puts everything to
1435 * the correct order later on.
1436 */
1437 rb_insert_augmented(&va->rb_node,
1438 root, &free_vmap_area_rb_augment_cb);
1439 va->subtree_max_size = 0;
1440 } else {
1441 rb_insert_color(&va->rb_node, root);
1442 }
1443
1444 /* Address-sort this list */
1445 list_add(&va->list, head);
1446}
1447
1451static __always_inline void
1452link_va(struct vmap_area *va, struct rb_root *root,
1453 struct rb_node *parent, struct rb_node **link,
1454 struct list_head *head)
1455{
1456 __link_va(va, root, parent, link, head, false);
1457}

1462static __always_inline void
1463link_va_augment(struct vmap_area *va, struct rb_root *root,
1464 struct rb_node *parent, struct rb_node **link,
1465 struct list_head *head)
1466{
1467 __link_va(va, root, parent, link, head, true);

1473static __always_inline void
1474__unlink_va(struct vmap_area *va, struct rb_root *root, bool augment)
1475{

1477 return;
1478
1479 if (augment)
1480 rb_erase_augmented(&va->rb_node,
1481 root, &free_vmap_area_rb_augment_cb);
1482 else
1483 rb_erase(&va->rb_node, root);
1484
1485 list_del_init(&va->list);
1486 RB_CLEAR_NODE(&va->rb_node);
1487}

1514static __always_inline unsigned long
1515compute_subtree_max_size(struct vmap_area *va)
1516{
1517 return max3(va_size(va),
1518 get_subtree_max_size(va->rb_node.rb_left),
1519 get_subtree_max_size(va->rb_node.rb_right));

1525static void
1526augment_tree_propagate_check(void)
1527{
1528 struct vmap_area *va;
1529 unsigned long computed_size;
1530
1531 list_for_each_entry(va, &free_vmap_area_list, list) {
1532 computed_size = compute_subtree_max_size(va);
1533 if (computed_size != va->subtree_max_size)
1534 pr_emerg("tree is corrupted: %lu, %lu\n",
1535 va_size(va), va->subtree_max_size);
1536 }
1537}
1538#endif

1570static __always_inline void
1571augment_tree_propagate_from(struct vmap_area *va)
1572{
1573 /*
1574 * Populate the tree from bottom towards the root until
1575 * the calculated maximum available size of checked node
1576 * is equal to its current one.
1577 */
1578 free_vmap_area_rb_augment_cb_propagate(&va->rb_node, NULL);
1579
1580#if DEBUG_AUGMENT_PROPAGATE_CHECK
1581 augment_tree_propagate_check();
1582#endif
1583}

1588static void
1589insert_vmap_area(struct vmap_area *va,
1590 struct rb_root *root, struct list_head *head)
1591{

1593 struct rb_node *parent;

1596 if (link)
1597 link_va(va, root, parent, link, head);

1603static void
1604insert_vmap_area_augment(struct vmap_area *va,
1605 struct rb_node *from, struct rb_root *root,
1606 struct list_head *head)
1607{
1608 struct rb_node **link;
1609 struct rb_node *parent;
1610
1611 if (from)
1612 link = find_va_links(va, NULL, from, &parent);
1613 else
1614 link = find_va_links(va, root, NULL, &parent);
1615
1616 if (link) {
1617 link_va_augment(va, root, parent, link, head);
1618 augment_tree_propagate_from(va);
1619 }
1620}

1636static __always_inline struct vmap_area *
1637__merge_or_add_vmap_area(struct vmap_area *va,
1638 struct rb_root *root, struct list_head *head, bool augment)
1639{
1640 struct vmap_area *sibling;
1641 struct list_head *next;
1642 struct rb_node **link;
1643 struct rb_node *parent;
1644 bool merged = false;
1645
1646 /*
1647 * Find a place in the tree where VA potentially will be
1648 * inserted, unless it is merged with its sibling/siblings.
1649 */
1650 link = find_va_links(va, root, NULL, &parent);
1651 if (!link)
1652 return NULL;
1653
1654 /*
1655 * Get next node of VA to check if merging can be done.
1656 */
1657 next = get_va_next_sibling(parent, link);
1658 if (unlikely(next == NULL))
1659 goto insert;
1660
1661 /*
1662 * start end
1663 * | |
1664 * |<------VA------>|<-----Next----->|
1665 * | |
1666 * start end
1667 */
1668 if (next != head) {
1669 sibling = list_entry(next, struct vmap_area, list);
1670 if (sibling->va_start == va->va_end) {
1671 sibling->va_start = va->va_start;
1672
1673 /* Free vmap_area object. */
1674 kmem_cache_free(vmap_area_cachep, va);
1675
1676 /* Point to the new merged area. */
1677 va = sibling;
1678 merged = true;
1679 }
1680 }
1681
1682 /*
1683 * start end
1684 * | |
1685 * |<-----Prev----->|<------VA------>|
1686 * | |
1687 * start end
1688 */
1689 if (next->prev != head) {
1690 sibling = list_entry(next->prev, struct vmap_area, list);
1691 if (sibling->va_end == va->va_start) {
1692 /*
1693 * If both neighbors are coalesced, it is important
1694 * to unlink the "next" node first, followed by merging
1695 * with "previous" one. Otherwise the tree might not be
1696 * fully populated if a sibling's augmented value is
1697 * "normalized" because of rotation operations.
1698 */
1699 if (merged)
1700 __unlink_va(va, root, augment);
1701
1702 sibling->va_end = va->va_end;
1703
1704 /* Free vmap_area object. */
1705 kmem_cache_free(vmap_area_cachep, va);
1706
1707 /* Point to the new merged area. */
1708 va = sibling;
1709 merged = true;
1710 }
1711 }
1712
1713insert:
1714 if (!merged)
1715 __link_va(va, root, parent, link, head, augment);
1716
1717 return va;
1718}
1719
1723static __always_inline struct vmap_area *
1724merge_or_add_vmap_area(struct vmap_area *va,
1725 struct rb_root *root, struct list_head *head)
1726{
1727 return __merge_or_add_vmap_area(va, root, head, false);
1728}
1729
1733static __always_inline struct vmap_area *
1734merge_or_add_vmap_area_augment(struct vmap_area *va,
1735 struct rb_root *root, struct list_head *head)
1736{
1737 va = __merge_or_add_vmap_area(va, root, head, true);
1738 if (va)
1739 augment_tree_propagate_from(va);
1740
1741 return va;
1742}

1747static __always_inline bool
1748is_within_this_va(struct vmap_area *va, unsigned long size,
1749 unsigned long align, unsigned long vstart)
1750{
1751 unsigned long nva_start_addr;
1752
1753 if (va->va_start > vstart)
1754 nva_start_addr = ALIGN(va->va_start, align);
1755 else
1756 nva_start_addr = ALIGN(vstart, align);
1757
1758 /* Can be overflowed due to big size or alignment. */
1759 if (nva_start_addr + size < nva_start_addr ||
1760 nva_start_addr < vstart)
1761 return false;
1762
1763 return (nva_start_addr + size <= va->va_end);
1764}
1765
1776static __always_inline struct vmap_area *
1777find_vmap_lowest_match(struct rb_root *root, unsigned long size,
1778 unsigned long align, unsigned long vstart, bool adjust_search_size)
1779{
1780 struct vmap_area *va;
1781 struct rb_node *node;
1782 unsigned long length;
1783
1784 /* Start from the root. */
1785 node = root->rb_node;
1786
1787 /* Adjust the search size for alignment overhead. */
1788 length = adjust_search_size ? size + align - 1 : size;
1789
1790 while (node) {
1791 va = rb_entry(node, struct vmap_area, rb_node);
1792
1793 if (get_subtree_max_size(node->rb_left) >= length &&
1794 vstart < va->va_start) {
1795 node = node->rb_left;
1796 } else {
1797 if (is_within_this_va(va, size, align, vstart))
1798 return va;
1799
1800 /*
1801 * Does not make sense to go deeper towards the right
1802 * sub-tree if it does not have a free block that is
1803 * equal or bigger to the requested search length.
1804 */
1805 if (get_subtree_max_size(node->rb_right) >= length) {
1806 node = node->rb_right;
1807 continue;
1808 }
1809
1810 /*
1811 * OK. We roll back and find the first right sub-tree,
1812 * that will satisfy the search criteria. It can happen
1813 * due to "vstart" restriction or an alignment overhead
1814 * that is bigger then PAGE_SIZE.
1815 */
1816 while ((node = rb_parent(node))) {
1817 va = rb_entry(node, struct vmap_area, rb_node);
1818 if (is_within_this_va(va, size, align, vstart))
1819 return va;
1820
1821 if (get_subtree_max_size(node->rb_right) >= length &&
1822 vstart <= va->va_start) {
1823 /*
1824 * Shift the vstart forward. Please note, we update it with
1825 * parent's start address adding "1" because we do not want
1826 * to enter same sub-tree after it has already been checked
1827 * and no suitable free block found there.
1828 */
1829 vstart = va->va_start + 1;
1830 node = node->rb_right;
1831 break;
1832 }
1833 }
1834 }
1835 }
1836
1837 return NULL;
1838}
1839
1840#if DEBUG_AUGMENT_LOWEST_MATCH_CHECK
1841#include <linux/random.h>
1842
1846static struct vmap_area *
1847find_vmap_lowest_linear_match(struct list_head *head, unsigned long size,
1848 unsigned long align, unsigned long vstart)
1849{
1850 struct vmap_area *va;
1851
1852 list_for_each_entry(va, head, list) {
1853 if (!is_within_this_va(va, size, align, vstart))
1854 continue;
1855
1856 return va;
1857 }
1858
1859 return NULL;
1860}
1861
1865static void
1866find_vmap_lowest_match_check(struct rb_root *root, struct list_head *head,
1867 unsigned long size, unsigned long align)
1868{
1869 struct vmap_area *va_1, *va_2;
1870 unsigned long vstart;
1871 unsigned int rnd;
1872
1873 get_random_bytes(&rnd, sizeof(rnd));
1874 vstart = VMALLOC_START + rnd;
1875
1876 va_1 = find_vmap_lowest_match(root, size, align, vstart, false);
1877 va_2 = find_vmap_lowest_linear_match(head, size, align, vstart);
1878
1879 if (va_1 != va_2)
1880 pr_emerg("not lowest: t: 0x%p, l: 0x%p, v: 0x%lx\n",
1881 va_1, va_2, vstart);
1882}
1883#endif
1884
1888enum fit_type {
1889 NOTHING_FIT = 0,
1890 FL_FIT_TYPE = 1, /* full fit */
1891 LE_FIT_TYPE = 2, /* left edge fit */
1892 RE_FIT_TYPE = 3, /* right edge fit */
1893 NE_FIT_TYPE = 4 /* no edge fit */
1894};
1895
1899static __always_inline enum fit_type
1900classify_va_fit_type(struct vmap_area *va,
1901 unsigned long nva_start_addr, unsigned long size)
1902{
1903 enum fit_type type;
1904
1905 /* Check if it is within VA. */
1906 if (nva_start_addr < va->va_start ||
1907 nva_start_addr + size > va->va_end)
1908 return NOTHING_FIT;
1909
1910 /* Now classify. */
1911 if (va->va_start == nva_start_addr) {
1912 if (va->va_end == nva_start_addr + size)
1913 type = FL_FIT_TYPE;
1914 else
1915 type = LE_FIT_TYPE;
1916 } else if (va->va_end == nva_start_addr + size) {
1917 type = RE_FIT_TYPE;
1918 } else {
1919 type = NE_FIT_TYPE;
1920 }
1921
1922 return type;
1923}
1924
1928static __always_inline int
1929va_clip(struct rb_root *root, struct list_head *head,
1930 struct vmap_area *va, unsigned long nva_start_addr,
1931 unsigned long size)
1932{
1933 struct vmap_area *lva = NULL;
1934 enum fit_type type = classify_va_fit_type(va, nva_start_addr, size);
1935
1936 if (type == FL_FIT_TYPE) {
1937 /*
1938 * No need to split VA, it fully fits.
1939 *
1940 * | |
1941 * V NVA V
1942 * |---------------|
1943 */
1944 unlink_va_augment(va, root);
1945 kmem_cache_free(vmap_area_cachep, va);
1946 } else if (type == LE_FIT_TYPE) {
1947 /*
1948 * Split left edge of fit VA.
1949 *
1950 * | |
1951 * V NVA V R
1952 * |-------|-------|
1953 */
1954 va->va_start += size;
1955 } else if (type == RE_FIT_TYPE) {
1956 /*
1957 * Split right edge of fit VA.
1958 *
1959 * | |
1960 * L V NVA V
1961 * |-------|-------|
1962 */
1963 va->va_end = nva_start_addr;
1964 } else if (type == NE_FIT_TYPE) {
1965 /*
1966 * Split no edge of fit VA.
1967 *
1968 * | |
1969 * L V NVA V R
1970 * |---|-------|---|
1971 */
1972 lva = __this_cpu_xchg(ne_fit_preload_node, NULL);
1973 if (unlikely(!lva)) {
1974 /*
1975 * For percpu allocator we do not do any pre-allocation
1976 * and leave it as it is. The reason is it most likely
1977 * never ends up with NE_FIT_TYPE splitting. In case of
1978 * percpu allocations offsets and sizes are aligned to
1979 * fixed align request, i.e. RE_FIT_TYPE and FL_FIT_TYPE
1980 * are its main fitting cases.
1981 *
1982 * There are a few exceptions though, as an example it is
1983 * a first allocation (early boot up) when we have "one"
1984 * big free space that has to be split.
1985 *
1986 * Also we can hit this path in case of regular "vmap"
1987 * allocations, if "this" current CPU was not preloaded.
1988 * See the comment in alloc_vmap_area() why. If so, then
1989 * GFP_NOWAIT is used instead to get an extra object for
1990 * split purpose. That is rare and most time does not
1991 * occur.
1992 *
1993 * What happens if an allocation gets failed. Basically,
1994 * an "overflow" path is triggered to purge lazily freed
1995 * areas to free some memory, then, the "retry" path is
1996 * triggered to repeat one more time. See more details
1997 * in alloc_vmap_area() function.
1998 */
1999 lva = kmem_cache_alloc(vmap_area_cachep, GFP_NOWAIT);
2000 if (!lva)
2001 return -ENOMEM;
2002 }
2003
2004 /*
2005 * Build the remainder.
2006 */
2007 lva->va_start = va->va_start;
2008 lva->va_end = nva_start_addr;
2009
2010 /*
2011 * Shrink this VA to remaining size.
2012 */
2013 va->va_start = nva_start_addr + size;
2014 } else {
2015 return -EINVAL;
2016 }
2017
2018 if (type != FL_FIT_TYPE) {
2019 augment_tree_propagate_from(va);
2020
2021 if (lva) /* type == NE_FIT_TYPE */
2022 insert_vmap_area_augment(lva, &va->rb_node, root, head);
2023 }
2024
2025 return 0;
2026}
2027
2031static unsigned long
2032va_alloc(struct vmap_area *va,
2033 struct rb_root *root, struct list_head *head,
2034 unsigned long size, unsigned long align,
2035 unsigned long vstart, unsigned long vend)
2036{
2037 unsigned long nva_start_addr;
2038 int ret;
2039
2040 if (va->va_start > vstart)
2041 nva_start_addr = ALIGN(va->va_start, align);
2042 else
2043 nva_start_addr = ALIGN(vstart, align);
2044
2045 /* Check the "vend" restriction. */
2046 if (nva_start_addr + size > vend)
2047 return -ERANGE;
2048
2049 /* Update the free vmap_area. */
2050 ret = va_clip(root, head, va, nva_start_addr, size);
2051 if (WARN_ON_ONCE(ret))
2052 return ret;
2053
2054 return nva_start_addr;
2055}
2056
2064static __always_inline unsigned long
2065__alloc_vmap_area(struct rb_root *root, struct list_head *head,
2066 unsigned long size, unsigned long align,
2067 unsigned long vstart, unsigned long vend)
2068{
2069 bool adjust_search_size = true;
2070 unsigned long nva_start_addr;
2071 struct vmap_area *va;
2072
2073 /*
2074 * Do not adjust when:
2075 * a) align <= PAGE_SIZE, because it does not make any sense.
2076 * All blocks(their start addresses) are at least PAGE_SIZE
2077 * aligned anyway;
2078 * b) a short range where a requested size corresponds to exactly
2079 * specified [vstart:vend] interval and an alignment > PAGE_SIZE.
2080 * With adjusted search length an allocation would not succeed.
2081 */
2082 if (align <= PAGE_SIZE || (align > PAGE_SIZE && (vend - vstart) == size))
2083 adjust_search_size = false;
2084
2085 va = find_vmap_lowest_match(root, size, align, vstart, adjust_search_size);
2086 if (unlikely(!va))
2087 return -ENOENT;
2088
2089 nva_start_addr = va_alloc(va, root, head, size, align, vstart, vend);
2090
2091#if DEBUG_AUGMENT_LOWEST_MATCH_CHECK
2092 if (!IS_ERR_VALUE(nva_start_addr))
2093 find_vmap_lowest_match_check(root, head, size, align);
2094#endif
2095
2096 return nva_start_addr;
2097}
2098
2105static void free_vmap_area(struct vmap_area *va)
2106{
2107 struct vmap_node *vn = addr_to_node(va->va_start);
2108
2109 /*
2110 * Remove from the busy tree/list.
2111 */
2112 spin_lock(&vn->busy.lock);
2113 unlink_va(va, &vn->busy.root);
2114 spin_unlock(&vn->busy.lock);
2115
2116 /*
2117 * Insert/Merge it back to the free tree/list.
2118 */
2119 spin_lock(&free_vmap_area_lock);
2120 merge_or_add_vmap_area_augment(va, &free_vmap_area_root, &free_vmap_area_list);
2121 spin_unlock(&free_vmap_area_lock);
2122}
2123
2127static inline void
2128preload_this_cpu_lock(spinlock_t *lock, gfp_t gfp_mask, int node)
2129{
2130 struct vmap_area *va = NULL, *tmp;
2131
2132 /*
2133 * Preload this CPU with one extra vmap_area object. It is used
2134 * when fit type of free area is NE_FIT_TYPE. It guarantees that
2135 * a CPU that does an allocation is preloaded.
2136 *
2137 * We do it in non-atomic context, thus it allows us to use more
2138 * permissive allocation masks to be more stable under low memory
2139 * condition and high memory pressure.
2140 */
2141 if (!this_cpu_read(ne_fit_preload_node))
2142 va = kmem_cache_alloc_node(vmap_area_cachep, gfp_mask, node);
2143
2144 spin_lock(lock);
2145
2146 tmp = NULL;
2147 if (va && !__this_cpu_try_cmpxchg(ne_fit_preload_node, &tmp, va))
2148 kmem_cache_free(vmap_area_cachep, va);
2149}
2150
2154static struct vmap_pool *
2155size_to_va_pool(struct vmap_node *vn, unsigned long size)
2156{
2157 unsigned int idx = (size - 1) / PAGE_SIZE;
2158
2159 if (idx < MAX_VA_SIZE_PAGES)
2160 return &vn->pool[idx];
2161
2162 return NULL;
2163}
2164
2168static bool
2169node_pool_add_va(struct vmap_node *n, struct vmap_area *va)
2170{
2171 struct vmap_pool *vp;
2172
2173 vp = size_to_va_pool(n, va_size(va));
2174 if (!vp)
2175 return false;
2176
2177 spin_lock(&n->pool_lock);
2178 list_add(&va->list, &vp->head);
2179 WRITE_ONCE(vp->len, vp->len + 1);
2180 spin_unlock(&n->pool_lock);
2181
2182 return true;
2183}
2184
2188static struct vmap_area *
2189node_pool_del_va(struct vmap_node *vn, unsigned long size,
2190 unsigned long align, unsigned long vstart,
2191 unsigned long vend)
2192{
2193 struct vmap_area *va = NULL;
2194 struct vmap_pool *vp;
2195 int err = 0;
2196
2197 vp = size_to_va_pool(vn, size);
2198 if (!vp || list_empty(&vp->head))
2199 return NULL;
2200
2201 spin_lock(&vn->pool_lock);
2202 if (!list_empty(&vp->head)) {
2203 va = list_first_entry(&vp->head, struct vmap_area, list);
2204
2205 if (IS_ALIGNED(va->va_start, align)) {
2206 /*
2207 * Do some sanity check and emit a warning
2208 * if one of below checks detects an error.
2209 */
2210 err |= (va_size(va) != size);
2211 err |= (va->va_start < vstart);
2212 err |= (va->va_end > vend);
2213
2214 if (!WARN_ON_ONCE(err)) {
2215 list_del_init(&va->list);
2216 WRITE_ONCE(vp->len, vp->len - 1);
2217 } else {
2218 va = NULL;
2219 }
2220 } else {
2221 list_move_tail(&va->list, &vp->head);
2222 va = NULL;
2223 }
2224 }
2225 spin_unlock(&vn->pool_lock);
2226
2227 return va;
2228}
2229
2233static struct vmap_area *
2234node_alloc(unsigned long size, unsigned long align,
2235 unsigned long vstart, unsigned long vend,
2236 unsigned long *addr, unsigned int *vn_id)
2237{
2238 struct vmap_area *va;
2239
2240 *vn_id = 0;
2241 *addr = -EINVAL;
2242
2243 /*
2244 * Fallback to a global heap if not vmalloc or there
2245 * is only one node.
2246 */
2247 if (vstart != VMALLOC_START || vend != VMALLOC_END ||
2248 nr_vmap_nodes == 1)
2249 return NULL;
2250
2251 *vn_id = raw_smp_processor_id() % nr_vmap_nodes;
2252 va = node_pool_del_va(id_to_node(*vn_id), size, align, vstart, vend);
2253 *vn_id = encode_vn_id(*vn_id);
2254
2255 if (va)
2256 *addr = va->va_start;
2257
2258 return va;
2259}

2264static inline void setup_vmalloc_vm(struct vm_struct *vm,
2265 struct vmap_area *va, unsigned long flags, const void *caller)
2266{
2267 vm->flags = flags;
2268 vm->addr = (void *)va->va_start;
2269 vm->size = vm->requested_size = va_size(va);
2270 vm->caller = caller;
2271 va->vm = vm;
2272}
2273
2281static struct vmap_area *alloc_vmap_area(unsigned long size,
2282 unsigned long align,
2283 unsigned long vstart, unsigned long vend,
2284 int node, gfp_t gfp_mask,
2285 unsigned long va_flags, struct vm_struct *vm)
2286{
2287 struct vmap_node *vn;
2288 struct vmap_area *va;
2289 unsigned long freed;
2290 unsigned long addr;
2291 unsigned int vn_id;
2292 bool allow_block;
2293 int purged = 0;
2294 int ret;
2295
2296 if (unlikely(!size || offset_in_page(size) || !is_power_of_2(align)))
2297 return ERR_PTR(-EINVAL);
2298
2299 if (unlikely(!vmap_initialized))
2300 return ERR_PTR(-EBUSY);
2301
2302 /* Only reclaim behaviour flags are relevant. */
2303 gfp_mask = gfp_mask & GFP_RECLAIM_MASK;
2304 allow_block = gfpflags_allow_blocking(gfp_mask);
2305 might_sleep_if(allow_block);
2306
2307 /*
2308 * If a VA is obtained from a global heap(if it fails here)
2309 * it is anyway marked with this "vn_id" so it is returned
2310 * to this pool's node later. Such way gives a possibility
2311 * to populate pools based on users demand.
2312 *
2313 * On success a ready to go VA is returned.
2314 */
2315 va = node_alloc(size, align, vstart, vend, &addr, &vn_id);
2316 if (!va) {
2317 va = kmem_cache_alloc_node(vmap_area_cachep, gfp_mask, node);
2318 if (unlikely(!va))
2319 return ERR_PTR(-ENOMEM);
2320
2321 /*
2322 * Only scan the relevant parts containing pointers to other objects
2323 * to avoid false negatives.
2324 */
2325 kmemleak_scan_area(&va->rb_node, SIZE_MAX, gfp_mask);
2326 }
2327
2328retry:
2329 if (IS_ERR_VALUE(addr)) {
2330 preload_this_cpu_lock(&free_vmap_area_lock, gfp_mask, node);
2331 addr = __alloc_vmap_area(&free_vmap_area_root, &free_vmap_area_list,
2332 size, align, vstart, vend);
2333 spin_unlock(&free_vmap_area_lock);
2334
2335 /*
2336 * This is not a fast path. Check if yielding is needed. This
2337 * is the only reschedule point in the vmalloc() path.
2338 */
2339 if (allow_block)
2340 cond_resched();
2341 }
2342
2343 trace_alloc_vmap_area(addr, size, align, vstart, vend, IS_ERR_VALUE(addr));
2344
2345 /*
2346 * If an allocation fails, the error value is
2347 * returned. Therefore trigger the overflow path.
2348 */
2349 if (IS_ERR_VALUE(addr)) {
2350 if (allow_block)
2351 goto overflow;
2352
2353 /*
2354 * We can not trigger any reclaim logic because
2355 * sleeping is not allowed, thus fail an allocation.
2356 */
2357 goto out_free_va;
2358 }
2359
2360 va->va_start = addr;
2361 va->va_end = addr + size;
2362 va->vm = NULL;
2363 va->flags = (va_flags | vn_id);
2364
2365 if (vm) {
2366 vm->addr = (void *)va->va_start;
2367 vm->size = va_size(va);
2368 va->vm = vm;
2369 }
2370
2371 vn = addr_to_node(va->va_start);
2372
2373 spin_lock(&vn->busy.lock);
2374 insert_vmap_area(va, &vn->busy.root, &vn->busy.head);
2375 spin_unlock(&vn->busy.lock);
2376
2377 BUG_ON(!IS_ALIGNED(va->va_start, align));
2378 BUG_ON(va->va_start < vstart);
2379 BUG_ON(va->va_end > vend);
2380
2381 ret = kasan_populate_vmalloc(addr, size, gfp_mask);
2382 if (ret) {
2383 free_vmap_area(va);
2384 return ERR_PTR(ret);
2385 }
2386
2387 return va;
2388
2389overflow:
2390 if (!purged) {
2391 reclaim_and_purge_vmap_areas();
2392 purged = 1;
2393 goto retry;
2394 }
2395
2396 freed = 0;
2397 blocking_notifier_call_chain(&vmap_notify_list, 0, &freed);
2398
2399 if (freed > 0) {
2400 purged = 0;
2401 goto retry;
2402 }
2403
2404 if (!(gfp_mask & __GFP_NOWARN) && printk_ratelimit())
2405 pr_warn("vmalloc_node_range for size %lu failed: Address range restricted to %#lx - %#lx\n",
2406 size, vstart, vend);
2407
2408out_free_va:
2409 kmem_cache_free(vmap_area_cachep, va);
2410 return ERR_PTR(-EBUSY);
2411}

2450static unsigned long lazy_max_pages(void)
2451{
2452 unsigned int log;
2453
2454 log = fls(num_online_cpus());
2455
2456 return log * (32UL * 1024 * 1024 / PAGE_SIZE);
2457}

2472static void
2473reclaim_list_global(struct list_head *head)
2474{
2475 struct vmap_area *va, *n;
2476
2477 if (list_empty(head))
2478 return;
2479
2480 spin_lock(&free_vmap_area_lock);
2481 list_for_each_entry_safe(va, n, head, list)
2482 merge_or_add_vmap_area_augment(va,
2483 &free_vmap_area_root, &free_vmap_area_list);
2484 spin_unlock(&free_vmap_area_lock);
2485}
2486
2490static void
2491decay_va_pool_node(struct vmap_node *vn, bool full_decay)
2492{
2493 LIST_HEAD(decay_list);
2494 struct rb_root decay_root = RB_ROOT;
2495 struct vmap_area *va, *nva;
2496 unsigned long n_decay, pool_len;
2497 int i;
2498
2499 for (i = 0; i < MAX_VA_SIZE_PAGES; i++) {
2500 LIST_HEAD(tmp_list);
2501
2502 if (list_empty(&vn->pool[i].head))
2503 continue;
2504
2505 /* Detach the pool, so no-one can access it. */
2506 spin_lock(&vn->pool_lock);
2507 list_replace_init(&vn->pool[i].head, &tmp_list);
2508 spin_unlock(&vn->pool_lock);
2509
2510 pool_len = n_decay = vn->pool[i].len;
2511 WRITE_ONCE(vn->pool[i].len, 0);
2512
2513 /* Decay a pool by ~25% out of left objects. */
2514 if (!full_decay)
2515 n_decay >>= 2;
2516 pool_len -= n_decay;
2517
2518 list_for_each_entry_safe(va, nva, &tmp_list, list) {
2519 if (!n_decay--)
2520 break;
2521
2522 list_del_init(&va->list);
2523 merge_or_add_vmap_area(va, &decay_root, &decay_list);
2524 }
2525
2526 /*
2527 * Attach the pool back if it has been partly decayed.
2528 * Please note, it is supposed that nobody(other contexts)
2529 * can populate the pool therefore a simple list replace
2530 * operation takes place here.
2531 */
2532 if (!list_empty(&tmp_list)) {
2533 spin_lock(&vn->pool_lock);
2534 list_replace_init(&tmp_list, &vn->pool[i].head);
2535 WRITE_ONCE(vn->pool[i].len, pool_len);
2536 spin_unlock(&vn->pool_lock);
2537 }
2538 }
2539
2540 reclaim_list_global(&decay_list);
2541}

2543#define KASAN_RELEASE_BATCH_SIZE 32
2544
2548static void
2549kasan_release_vmalloc_node(struct vmap_node *vn)
2550{
2551 struct vmap_area *va;
2552 unsigned long start, end;
2553 unsigned int batch_count = 0;
2554
2555 start = list_first_entry(&vn->purge_list, struct vmap_area, list)->va_start;
2556 end = list_last_entry(&vn->purge_list, struct vmap_area, list)->va_end;
2557
2558 list_for_each_entry(va, &vn->purge_list, list) {
2559 if (is_vmalloc_or_module_addr((void *) va->va_start))
2560 kasan_release_vmalloc(va->va_start, va->va_end,
2561 va->va_start, va->va_end,
2562 KASAN_VMALLOC_PAGE_RANGE);
2563
2564 if (need_resched() || (++batch_count >= KASAN_RELEASE_BATCH_SIZE)) {
2565 cond_resched();
2566 batch_count = 0;
2567 }
2568 }
2569
2570 kasan_release_vmalloc(start, end, start, end, KASAN_VMALLOC_TLB_FLUSH);
2571}
2572
2576static void purge_vmap_node(struct work_struct *work)
2577{
2578 struct vmap_node *vn = container_of(work,
2579 struct vmap_node, purge_work);
2580 unsigned long nr_purged_pages = 0;
2581 struct vmap_area *va, *n_va;
2582 LIST_HEAD(local_list);
2583
2584 if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_KASAN_VMALLOC))
2585 kasan_release_vmalloc_node(vn);
2586
2587 vn->nr_purged = 0;
2588
2589 list_for_each_entry_safe(va, n_va, &vn->purge_list, list) {
2590 unsigned long nr = va_size(va) >> PAGE_SHIFT;
2591 unsigned int vn_id = decode_vn_id(va->flags);
2592
2593 list_del_init(&va->list);
2594
2595 nr_purged_pages += nr;
2596 vn->nr_purged++;
2597
2598 if (is_vn_id_valid(vn_id) && !vn->skip_populate)
2599 if (node_pool_add_va(vn, va))
2600 continue;
2601
2602 /* Go back to global. */
2603 list_add(&va->list, &local_list);
2604 }
2605
2606 atomic_long_sub(nr_purged_pages, &vmap_lazy_nr);
2607
2608 reclaim_list_global(&local_list);
2609}
2610
2617static bool __purge_vmap_area_lazy(unsigned long start, unsigned long end,
2618 bool full_pool_decay)
2619{
2620 unsigned long nr_purged_areas = 0;
2621 unsigned int nr_purge_helpers;
2622 static cpumask_t purge_nodes;
2623 unsigned int nr_purge_nodes;
2624 struct vmap_node *vn;
2625 int i;
2626
2627 lockdep_assert_held(&vmap_purge_lock);
2628
2629 /*
2630 * Use cpumask to mark which node has to be processed.
2631 */
2632 purge_nodes = CPU_MASK_NONE;
2633
2634 for_each_vmap_node(vn) {
2635 INIT_LIST_HEAD(&vn->purge_list);
2636 vn->skip_populate = full_pool_decay;
2637 decay_va_pool_node(vn, full_pool_decay);
2638
2639 if (RB_EMPTY_ROOT(&vn->lazy.root))
2640 continue;
2641
2642 spin_lock(&vn->lazy.lock);
2643 WRITE_ONCE(vn->lazy.root.rb_node, NULL);
2644 list_replace_init(&vn->lazy.head, &vn->purge_list);
2645 spin_unlock(&vn->lazy.lock);
2646
2647 start = min(start, list_first_entry(&vn->purge_list,
2648 struct vmap_area, list)->va_start);
2649
2650 end = max(end, list_last_entry(&vn->purge_list,
2651 struct vmap_area, list)->va_end);
2652
2653 cpumask_set_cpu(node_to_id(vn), &purge_nodes);
2654 }
2655
2656 nr_purge_nodes = cpumask_weight(&purge_nodes);
2657 if (nr_purge_nodes > 0) {
2658 flush_tlb_kernel_range(start, end);
2659
2660 /* One extra worker is per a lazy_max_pages() full set minus one. */
2661 nr_purge_helpers = atomic_long_read(&vmap_lazy_nr) / lazy_max_pages();
2662 nr_purge_helpers = clamp(nr_purge_helpers, 1U, nr_purge_nodes) - 1;
2663
2664 for_each_cpu(i, &purge_nodes) {
2665 vn = &vmap_nodes[i];
2666
2667 if (nr_purge_helpers > 0) {
2668 INIT_WORK(&vn->purge_work, purge_vmap_node);
2669
2670 if (cpumask_test_cpu(i, cpu_online_mask))
2671 schedule_work_on(i, &vn->purge_work);
2672 else
2673 schedule_work(&vn->purge_work);
2674
2675 nr_purge_helpers--;
2676 } else {
2677 vn->purge_work.func = NULL;
2678 purge_vmap_node(&vn->purge_work);
2679 nr_purged_areas += vn->nr_purged;
2680 }
2681 }
2682
2683 for_each_cpu(i, &purge_nodes) {
2684 vn = &vmap_nodes[i];
2685
2686 if (vn->purge_work.func) {
2687 flush_work(&vn->purge_work);
2688 nr_purged_areas += vn->nr_purged;
2689 }
2690 }
2691 }
2692
2693 trace_purge_vmap_area_lazy(start, end, nr_purged_areas);
2694 return nr_purged_areas > 0;
2695}
2696
2703static void reclaim_and_purge_vmap_areas(void)
2704
2705{
2706 mutex_lock(&vmap_purge_lock);
2707 purge_fragmented_blocks_allcpus();
2708 __purge_vmap_area_lazy(ULONG_MAX, 0, true);
2709 mutex_unlock(&vmap_purge_lock);
2710}
2711
2715static void drain_vmap_area_work(struct work_struct *work)
2716{
2717 mutex_lock(&vmap_purge_lock);
2718 __purge_vmap_area_lazy(ULONG_MAX, 0, false);
2719 mutex_unlock(&vmap_purge_lock);
2720}
2721
2730static void free_vmap_area_noflush(struct vmap_area *va)
2731{
2732 unsigned long nr_lazy_max = lazy_max_pages();
2733 unsigned long va_start = va->va_start;
2734 unsigned int vn_id = decode_vn_id(va->flags);
2735 struct vmap_node *vn;
2736 unsigned long nr_lazy;
2737
2738 if (WARN_ON_ONCE(!list_empty(&va->list)))
2739 return;
2740
2741 nr_lazy = atomic_long_add_return_relaxed(va_size(va) >> PAGE_SHIFT,
2742 &vmap_lazy_nr);
2743
2744 /*
2745 * If it was request by a certain node we would like to
2746 * return it to that node, i.e. its pool for later reuse.
2747 */
2748 vn = is_vn_id_valid(vn_id) ?
2749 id_to_node(vn_id):addr_to_node(va->va_start);
2750
2751 spin_lock(&vn->lazy.lock);
2752 insert_vmap_area(va, &vn->lazy.root, &vn->lazy.head);
2753 spin_unlock(&vn->lazy.lock);
2754
2755 trace_free_vmap_area_noflush(va_start, nr_lazy, nr_lazy_max);
2756
2757 /* After this point, we may free va at any time */
2758 if (unlikely(nr_lazy > nr_lazy_max))
2759 schedule_work(&drain_vmap_work);
2760}
2761
2768static void free_unmap_vmap_area(struct vmap_area *va)
2769{
2770 flush_cache_vunmap(va->va_start, va->va_end);
2771 vunmap_range_noflush(va->va_start, va->va_end);
2772 if (debug_pagealloc_enabled_static())
2773 flush_tlb_kernel_range(va->va_start, va->va_end);
2774
2775 free_vmap_area_noflush(va);
2776}
2777
2781struct vmap_area *find_vmap_area(unsigned long addr)
2782{
2783 struct vmap_node *vn;
2784 struct vmap_area *va;
2785 int i, j;
2786
2787 if (unlikely(!vmap_initialized))
2788 return NULL;
2789
2790 /*
2791 * An addr_to_node_id(addr) converts an address to a node index
2792 * where a VA is located. If VA spans several zones and passed
2793 * addr is not the same as va->va_start, what is not common, we
2794 * may need to scan extra nodes. See an example:
2795 *
2796 * <----va---->
2797 * -|-----|-----|-----|-----|-
2798 * 1 2 0 1
2799 *
2800 * VA resides in node 1 whereas it spans 1, 2 an 0. If passed
2801 * addr is within 2 or 0 nodes we should do extra work.
2802 */
2803 i = j = addr_to_node_id(addr);
2804 do {
2805 vn = &vmap_nodes[i];
2806
2807 spin_lock(&vn->busy.lock);
2808 va = __find_vmap_area(addr, &vn->busy.root);
2809 spin_unlock(&vn->busy.lock);
2810
2811 if (va)
2812 return va;
2813 } while ((i = (i + nr_vmap_nodes - 1) % nr_vmap_nodes) != j);
2814
2815 return NULL;
2816}
2817
2821static struct vmap_area *find_unlink_vmap_area(unsigned long addr)
2822{
2823 struct vmap_node *vn;
2824 struct vmap_area *va;
2825 int i, j;
2826
2827 /*
2828 * Check the comment in the find_vmap_area() about the loop.
2829 */
2830 i = j = addr_to_node_id(addr);
2831 do {
2832 vn = &vmap_nodes[i];
2833
2834 spin_lock(&vn->busy.lock);
2835 va = __find_vmap_area(addr, &vn->busy.root);
2836 if (va)
2837 unlink_va(va, &vn->busy.root);
2838 spin_unlock(&vn->busy.lock);
2839
2840 if (va)
2841 return va;
2842 } while ((i = (i + nr_vmap_nodes - 1) % nr_vmap_nodes) != j);
2843
2844 return NULL;
2845}
2846
2847/*** Per cpu kva allocator ***/
2848
2849/*
2850 * vmap space is limited especially on 32 bit architectures. Ensure there is
2851 * room for at least 16 percpu vmap blocks per CPU.
2852 */
2858#if BITS_PER_LONG == 32
2859#define VMALLOC_SPACE (128UL*1024*1024)
2860#else
2861#define VMALLOC_SPACE (128UL*1024*1024*1024)
2862#endif
2863
2864#define VMALLOC_PAGES (VMALLOC_SPACE / PAGE_SIZE)
2865#define VMAP_MAX_ALLOC BITS_PER_LONG
2866#define VMAP_BBMAP_BITS_MAX 1024
2867#define VMAP_BBMAP_BITS_MIN (VMAP_MAX_ALLOC*2)
2868#define VMAP_MIN(x, y) ((x) < (y) ? (x) : (y))
2869#define VMAP_MAX(x, y) ((x) > (y) ? (x) : (y))
2870#define VMAP_BBMAP_BITS \
2871 VMAP_MIN(VMAP_BBMAP_BITS_MAX, \
2872 VMAP_MAX(VMAP_BBMAP_BITS_MIN, \
2873 VMALLOC_PAGES / roundup_pow_of_two(NR_CPUS) / 16))
2874
2875#define VMAP_BLOCK_SIZE (VMAP_BBMAP_BITS * PAGE_SIZE)
2876
2881#define VMAP_PURGE_THRESHOLD (VMAP_BBMAP_BITS / 4)
2882
2883#define VMAP_RAM 0x1
2884#define VMAP_BLOCK 0x2
2885#define VMAP_FLAGS_MASK 0x3
2886
2890struct vmap_block_queue {
2891 spinlock_t lock;
2892 struct list_head free;
2893
2894 /*
2895 * An xarray requires an extra memory dynamically to
2896 * be allocated. If it is an issue, we can use rb-tree
2897 * instead.
2898 */
2899 struct xarray vmap_blocks;
2900};
2901
2905struct vmap_block {
2906 spinlock_t lock;
2907 struct vmap_area *va;
2908 unsigned long free, dirty;
2909 DECLARE_BITMAP(used_map, VMAP_BBMAP_BITS);
2910 unsigned long dirty_min, dirty_max; /*< dirty range */
2911 struct list_head free_list;
2912 struct rcu_head rcu_head;
2913 struct list_head purge;
2914 unsigned int cpu;
2915};
2916
2918static DEFINE_PER_CPU(struct vmap_block_queue, vmap_block_queue);
2919
2959static struct xarray *
2960addr_to_vb_xa(unsigned long addr)
2961{
2962 int index = (addr / VMAP_BLOCK_SIZE) % nr_cpu_ids;
2963
2964 /*
2965 * Please note, nr_cpu_ids points on a highest set
2966 * possible bit, i.e. we never invoke cpumask_next()
2967 * if an index points on it which is nr_cpu_ids - 1.
2968 */
2969 if (!cpu_possible(index))
2970 index = cpumask_next(index, cpu_possible_mask);
2971
2972 return &per_cpu(vmap_block_queue, index).vmap_blocks;
2973}
2974
2984
2985static unsigned long addr_to_vb_idx(unsigned long addr)
2986{
2987 addr -= VMALLOC_START & ~(VMAP_BLOCK_SIZE-1);
2988 addr /= VMAP_BLOCK_SIZE;
2989 return addr;
2990}
2991
2995static void *vmap_block_vaddr(unsigned long va_start, unsigned long pages_off)
2996{
2997 unsigned long addr;
2998
2999 addr = va_start + (pages_off << PAGE_SHIFT);
3000 BUG_ON(addr_to_vb_idx(addr) != addr_to_vb_idx(va_start));
3001 return (void *)addr;
3002}
3003
3015static void *new_vmap_block(unsigned int order, gfp_t gfp_mask)
3016{
3017 struct vmap_block_queue *vbq;
3018 struct vmap_block *vb;
3019 struct vmap_area *va;
3020 struct xarray *xa;
3021 unsigned long vb_idx;
3022 int node, err;
3023 void *vaddr;
3024
3025 node = numa_node_id();
3026
3027 vb = kmalloc_node(sizeof(struct vmap_block), gfp_mask, node);
3028 if (unlikely(!vb))
3029 return ERR_PTR(-ENOMEM);
3030
3031 va = alloc_vmap_area(VMAP_BLOCK_SIZE, VMAP_BLOCK_SIZE,
3032 VMALLOC_START, VMALLOC_END,
3033 node, gfp_mask,
3034 VMAP_RAM|VMAP_BLOCK, NULL);
3035 if (IS_ERR(va)) {
3036 kfree(vb);
3037 return ERR_CAST(va);
3038 }
3039
3040 vaddr = vmap_block_vaddr(va->va_start, 0);
3041 spin_lock_init(&vb->lock);
3042 vb->va = va;
3043 /* At least something should be left free */
3044 BUG_ON(VMAP_BBMAP_BITS <= (1UL << order));
3045 bitmap_zero(vb->used_map, VMAP_BBMAP_BITS);
3046 vb->free = VMAP_BBMAP_BITS - (1UL << order);
3047 vb->dirty = 0;
3048 vb->dirty_min = VMAP_BBMAP_BITS;
3049 vb->dirty_max = 0;
3050 bitmap_set(vb->used_map, 0, (1UL << order));
3051 INIT_LIST_HEAD(&vb->free_list);
3052 vb->cpu = raw_smp_processor_id();
3053
3054 xa = addr_to_vb_xa(va->va_start);
3055 vb_idx = addr_to_vb_idx(va->va_start);
3056 err = xa_insert(xa, vb_idx, vb, gfp_mask);
3057 if (err) {
3058 kfree(vb);
3059 free_vmap_area(va);
3060 return ERR_PTR(err);
3061 }
3062 /*
3063 * list_add_tail_rcu could happened in another core
3064 * rather than vb->cpu due to task migration, which
3065 * is safe as list_add_tail_rcu will ensure the list's
3066 * integrity together with list_for_each_rcu from read
3067 * side.
3068 */
3069 vbq = per_cpu_ptr(&vmap_block_queue, vb->cpu);
3070 spin_lock(&vbq->lock);
3071 list_add_tail_rcu(&vb->free_list, &vbq->free);
3072 spin_unlock(&vbq->lock);
3073
3074 return vaddr;
3075}
3076
3080static void free_vmap_block(struct vmap_block *vb)
3081{
3082 struct vmap_node *vn;
3083 struct vmap_block *tmp;
3084 struct xarray *xa;
3085
3086 xa = addr_to_vb_xa(vb->va->va_start);
3087 tmp = xa_erase(xa, addr_to_vb_idx(vb->va->va_start));
3088 BUG_ON(tmp != vb);
3089
3090 vn = addr_to_node(vb->va->va_start);
3091 spin_lock(&vn->busy.lock);
3092 unlink_va(vb->va, &vn->busy.root);
3093 spin_unlock(&vn->busy.lock);
3094
3095 free_vmap_area_noflush(vb->va);
3096 kfree_rcu(vb, rcu_head);
3097}
3098
3102static bool purge_fragmented_block(struct vmap_block *vb,
3103 struct list_head *purge_list, bool force_purge)
3104{
3105 struct vmap_block_queue *vbq = &per_cpu(vmap_block_queue, vb->cpu);
3106
3107 if (vb->free + vb->dirty != VMAP_BBMAP_BITS ||
3108 vb->dirty == VMAP_BBMAP_BITS)
3109 return false;
3110
3111 /* Don't overeagerly purge usable blocks unless requested */
3112 if (!(force_purge || vb->free < VMAP_PURGE_THRESHOLD))
3113 return false;
3114
3115 /* prevent further allocs after releasing lock */
3116 WRITE_ONCE(vb->free, 0);
3117 /* prevent purging it again */
3118 WRITE_ONCE(vb->dirty, VMAP_BBMAP_BITS);
3119 vb->dirty_min = 0;
3120 vb->dirty_max = VMAP_BBMAP_BITS;
3121 spin_lock(&vbq->lock);
3122 list_del_rcu(&vb->free_list);
3123 spin_unlock(&vbq->lock);
3124 list_add_tail(&vb->purge, purge_list);
3125 return true;
3126}
3127
3131static void free_purged_blocks(struct list_head *purge_list)
3132{
3133 struct vmap_block *vb, *n_vb;
3134
3135 list_for_each_entry_safe(vb, n_vb, purge_list, purge) {
3136 list_del(&vb->purge);
3137 free_vmap_block(vb);
3138 }
3139}
3140
3144static void purge_fragmented_blocks(int cpu)
3145{
3146 LIST_HEAD(purge);
3147 struct vmap_block *vb;
3148 struct vmap_block_queue *vbq = &per_cpu(vmap_block_queue, cpu);
3149
3150 rcu_read_lock();
3151 list_for_each_entry_rcu(vb, &vbq->free, free_list) {
3152 unsigned long free = READ_ONCE(vb->free);
3153 unsigned long dirty = READ_ONCE(vb->dirty);
3154
3155 if (free + dirty != VMAP_BBMAP_BITS ||
3156 dirty == VMAP_BBMAP_BITS)
3157 continue;
3158
3159 spin_lock(&vb->lock);
3160 purge_fragmented_block(vb, &purge, true);
3161 spin_unlock(&vb->lock);
3162 }
3163 rcu_read_unlock();
3164 free_purged_blocks(&purge);
3165}
3166
3170static void purge_fragmented_blocks_allcpus(void)
3171{
3172 int cpu;
3173
3174 for_each_possible_cpu(cpu)
3175 purge_fragmented_blocks(cpu);
3176}
3177
3181static void *vb_alloc(unsigned long size, gfp_t gfp_mask)
3182{
3183 struct vmap_block_queue *vbq;
3184 struct vmap_block *vb;
3185 void *vaddr = NULL;
3186 unsigned int order;
3187
3188 BUG_ON(offset_in_page(size));
3189 BUG_ON(size > PAGE_SIZE*VMAP_MAX_ALLOC);
3190 if (WARN_ON(size == 0)) {
3191 /*
3192 * Allocating 0 bytes isn't what caller wants since
3193 * get_order(0) returns funny result. Just warn and terminate
3194 * early.
3195 */
3196 return ERR_PTR(-EINVAL);
3197 }
3198 order = get_order(size);
3199
3200 rcu_read_lock();
3201 vbq = raw_cpu_ptr(&vmap_block_queue);
3202 list_for_each_entry_rcu(vb, &vbq->free, free_list) {
3203 unsigned long pages_off;
3204
3205 if (READ_ONCE(vb->free) < (1UL << order))
3206 continue;
3207
3208 spin_lock(&vb->lock);
3209 if (vb->free < (1UL << order)) {
3210 spin_unlock(&vb->lock);
3211 continue;
3212 }
3213
3214 pages_off = VMAP_BBMAP_BITS - vb->free;
3215 vaddr = vmap_block_vaddr(vb->va->va_start, pages_off);
3216 WRITE_ONCE(vb->free, vb->free - (1UL << order));
3217 bitmap_set(vb->used_map, pages_off, (1UL << order));
3218 if (vb->free == 0) {
3219 spin_lock(&vbq->lock);
3220 list_del_rcu(&vb->free_list);
3221 spin_unlock(&vbq->lock);
3222 }
3223
3224 spin_unlock(&vb->lock);
3225 break;
3226 }
3227
3228 rcu_read_unlock();
3229
3230 /* Allocate new block if nothing was found */
3231 if (!vaddr)
3232 vaddr = new_vmap_block(order, gfp_mask);
3233
3234 return vaddr;
3235}
3236
3240static void vb_free(unsigned long addr, unsigned long size)
3241{
3242 unsigned long offset;
3243 unsigned int order;
3244 struct vmap_block *vb;
3245 struct xarray *xa;
3246
3247 BUG_ON(offset_in_page(size));
3248 BUG_ON(size > PAGE_SIZE*VMAP_MAX_ALLOC);
3249
3250 flush_cache_vunmap(addr, addr + size);
3251
3252 order = get_order(size);
3253 offset = (addr & (VMAP_BLOCK_SIZE - 1)) >> PAGE_SHIFT;
3254
3255 xa = addr_to_vb_xa(addr);
3256 vb = xa_load(xa, addr_to_vb_idx(addr));
3257
3258 spin_lock(&vb->lock);
3259 bitmap_clear(vb->used_map, offset, (1UL << order));
3260 spin_unlock(&vb->lock);
3261
3262 vunmap_range_noflush(addr, addr + size);
3263
3264 if (debug_pagealloc_enabled_static())
3265 flush_tlb_kernel_range(addr, addr + size);
3266
3267 spin_lock(&vb->lock);
3268
3269 /* Expand the not yet TLB flushed dirty range */
3270 vb->dirty_min = min(vb->dirty_min, offset);
3271 vb->dirty_max = max(vb->dirty_max, offset + (1UL << order));
3272
3273 WRITE_ONCE(vb->dirty, vb->dirty + (1UL << order));
3274 if (vb->dirty == VMAP_BBMAP_BITS) {
3275 BUG_ON(vb->free);
3276 spin_unlock(&vb->lock);
3277 free_vmap_block(vb);
3278 } else
3279 spin_unlock(&vb->lock);
3280}
3281
3285static void _vm_unmap_aliases(unsigned long start, unsigned long end, int flush)
3286{
3287 LIST_HEAD(purge_list);
3288 int cpu;
3289
3290 if (unlikely(!vmap_initialized))
3291 return;
3292
3293 mutex_lock(&vmap_purge_lock);
3294
3295 for_each_possible_cpu(cpu) {
3296 struct vmap_block_queue *vbq = &per_cpu(vmap_block_queue, cpu);
3297 struct vmap_block *vb;
3298 unsigned long idx;
3299
3300 rcu_read_lock();
3301 xa_for_each(&vbq->vmap_blocks, idx, vb) {
3302 spin_lock(&vb->lock);
3303
3304 /*
3305 * Try to purge a fragmented block first. If it's
3306 * not purgeable, check whether there is dirty
3307 * space to be flushed.
3308 */
3309 if (!purge_fragmented_block(vb, &purge_list, false) &&
3310 vb->dirty_max && vb->dirty != VMAP_BBMAP_BITS) {
3311 unsigned long va_start = vb->va->va_start;
3312 unsigned long s, e;
3313
3314 s = va_start + (vb->dirty_min << PAGE_SHIFT);
3315 e = va_start + (vb->dirty_max << PAGE_SHIFT);
3316
3317 start = min(s, start);
3318 end = max(e, end);
3319
3320 /* Prevent that this is flushed again */
3321 vb->dirty_min = VMAP_BBMAP_BITS;
3322 vb->dirty_max = 0;
3323
3324 flush = 1;
3325 }
3326 spin_unlock(&vb->lock);
3327 }
3328 rcu_read_unlock();
3329 }
3330 free_purged_blocks(&purge_list);
3331
3332 if (!__purge_vmap_area_lazy(start, end, false) && flush)
3333 flush_tlb_kernel_range(start, end);
3334 mutex_unlock(&vmap_purge_lock);
3335}
3336
3353void vm_unmap_aliases(void)
3354{
3355 _vm_unmap_aliases(ULONG_MAX, 0, 0);
3356}
3357EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL(vm_unmap_aliases);
3358
3367void vm_unmap_ram(const void *mem, unsigned int count)
3368{
3369 unsigned long size = (unsigned long)count << PAGE_SHIFT;
3370 unsigned long addr = (unsigned long)kasan_reset_tag(mem);
3371 struct vmap_area *va;
3372
3373 might_sleep();
3374 BUG_ON(!addr);
3375 BUG_ON(addr < VMALLOC_START);
3376 BUG_ON(addr > VMALLOC_END);
3377 BUG_ON(!PAGE_ALIGNED(addr));
3378
3379 kasan_poison_vmalloc(mem, size);
3380
3381 if (likely(count <= VMAP_MAX_ALLOC)) {
3382 debug_check_no_locks_freed(mem, size);
3383 vb_free(addr, size);
3384 return;
3385 }
3386
3387 va = find_unlink_vmap_area(addr);
3388 if (WARN_ON_ONCE(!va))
3389 return;
3390
3391 debug_check_no_locks_freed((void *)va->va_start, va_size(va));
3392 free_unmap_vmap_area(va);
3393}
3394EXPORT_SYMBOL(vm_unmap_ram);
3395
3413void *vm_map_ram(struct page **pages, unsigned int count, int node)
3414{
3415 unsigned long size = (unsigned long)count << PAGE_SHIFT;
3416 unsigned long addr;
3417 void *mem;
3418
3419 if (likely(count <= VMAP_MAX_ALLOC)) {
3420 mem = vb_alloc(size, GFP_KERNEL);
3421 if (IS_ERR(mem))
3422 return NULL;
3423 addr = (unsigned long)mem;
3424 } else {
3425 struct vmap_area *va;
3426 va = alloc_vmap_area(size, PAGE_SIZE,
3427 VMALLOC_START, VMALLOC_END,
3428 node, GFP_KERNEL, VMAP_RAM,
3429 NULL);
3430 if (IS_ERR(va))
3431 return NULL;
3432
3433 addr = va->va_start;
3434 mem = (void *)addr;
3435 }
3436
3437 if (vmap_pages_range(addr, addr + size, PAGE_KERNEL,
3438 pages, PAGE_SHIFT) < 0) {
3439 vm_unmap_ram(mem, count);
3440 return NULL;
3441 }
3442
3443 /*
3444 * Mark the pages as accessible, now that they are mapped.
3445 * With hardware tag-based KASAN, marking is skipped for
3446 * non-VM_ALLOC mappings, see __kasan_unpoison_vmalloc().
3447 */
3448 mem = kasan_unpoison_vmalloc(mem, size, KASAN_VMALLOC_PROT_NORMAL);
3449
3450 return mem;
3451}
3452EXPORT_SYMBOL(vm_map_ram);

3501void __init vm_area_add_early(struct vm_struct *vm)
3502{
3503 struct vm_struct *tmp, **p;
3504
3505 BUG_ON(vmap_initialized);
3506 for (p = &vmlist; (tmp = *p) != NULL; p = &tmp->next) {
3507 if (tmp->addr >= vm->addr) {
3508 BUG_ON(tmp->addr < vm->addr + vm->size);
3509 break;
3510 } else
3511 BUG_ON(tmp->addr + tmp->size > vm->addr);
3512 }
3513 vm->next = *p;
3514 *p = vm;
3515}

3532void __init vm_area_register_early(struct vm_struct *vm, size_t align)
3533{
3534 unsigned long addr = ALIGN(VMALLOC_START, align);
3535 struct vm_struct *cur, **p;
3536
3537 BUG_ON(vmap_initialized);
3538
3539 for (p = &vmlist; (cur = *p) != NULL; p = &cur->next) {
3540 if ((unsigned long)cur->addr - addr >= vm->size)
3541 break;
3542 addr = ALIGN((unsigned long)cur->addr + cur->size, align);
3543 }
3544
3545 BUG_ON(addr > VMALLOC_END - vm->size);
3546 vm->addr = (void *)addr;
3547 vm->next = *p;
3548 *p = vm;
3549 kasan_populate_early_vm_area_shadow(vm->addr, vm->size);
3550}

3569struct vm_struct *__get_vm_area_node(unsigned long size,
3570 unsigned long align, unsigned long shift, unsigned long flags,
3571 unsigned long start, unsigned long end, int node,
3572 gfp_t gfp_mask, const void *caller)
3573{
3574 struct vmap_area *va;
3575 struct vm_struct *area;
3576 unsigned long requested_size = size;
3577
3578 BUG_ON(in_nmi() || in_hardirq());
3579 size = ALIGN(size, 1ul << shift);
3580 if (unlikely(!size))
3581 return NULL;
3582
3583 if (flags & VM_IOREMAP)
3584 align = 1ul << clamp_t(int, get_count_order_long(size),
3585 PAGE_SHIFT, IOREMAP_MAX_ORDER);
3586
3587 area = kzalloc_node(sizeof(*area), gfp_mask & GFP_RECLAIM_MASK, node);
3588 if (unlikely(!area))
3589 return NULL;
3590
3591 if (!(flags & VM_NO_GUARD))
3592 size += PAGE_SIZE;
3593
3594 area->flags = flags;
3595 area->caller = caller;
3596 area->requested_size = requested_size;
3597
3598 va = alloc_vmap_area(size, align, start, end, node, gfp_mask, 0, area);
3599 if (IS_ERR(va)) {
3600 kfree(area);
3601 return NULL;
3602 }
3603
3604 /*
3605 * Mark pages for non-VM_ALLOC mappings as accessible. Do it now as a
3606 * best-effort approach, as they can be mapped outside of vmalloc code.
3607 * For VM_ALLOC mappings, the pages are marked as accessible after
3608 * getting mapped in __vmalloc_node_range().
3609 * With hardware tag-based KASAN, marking is skipped for
3610 * non-VM_ALLOC mappings, see __kasan_unpoison_vmalloc().
3611 */
3612 if (!(flags & VM_ALLOC))
3613 area->addr = kasan_unpoison_vmalloc(area->addr, requested_size,
3614 KASAN_VMALLOC_PROT_NORMAL);
3615
3616 return area;
3617}

3622struct vm_struct *__get_vm_area_caller(unsigned long size, unsigned long flags,

3625{

3627 NUMA_NO_NODE, GFP_KERNEL, caller);

3701struct vm_struct *remove_vm_area(const void *addr)
3702{

3705
3706 might_sleep();
3707
3708 if (WARN(!PAGE_ALIGNED(addr), "Trying to vfree() bad address (%p)\n",
3709 addr))
3710 return NULL;
3711
3712 va = find_unlink_vmap_area((unsigned long)addr);
3713 if (!va || !va->vm)

3715 vm = va->vm;

3717 debug_check_no_locks_freed(vm->addr, get_vm_area_size(vm));
3718 debug_check_no_obj_freed(vm->addr, get_vm_area_size(vm));
3719 kasan_free_module_shadow(vm);

3721
3722 free_unmap_vmap_area(va);
3723 return vm;

3729static inline void set_area_direct_map(const struct vm_struct *area,
3730 int (*set_direct_map)(struct page *page))
3731{
3732 int i;
3733
3734 /* HUGE_VMALLOC passes small pages to set_direct_map */
3735 for (i = 0; i < area->nr_pages; i++)
3736 if (page_address(area->pages[i]))
3737 set_direct_map(area->pages[i]);
3738}
3739
3746static void vm_reset_perms(struct vm_struct *area)
3747{
3748 unsigned long start = ULONG_MAX, end = 0;
3749 unsigned int page_order = vm_area_page_order(area);
3750 int flush_dmap = 0;
3751 int i;
3752
3753 /*
3754 * Find the start and end range of the direct mappings to make sure that
3755 * the vm_unmap_aliases() flush includes the direct map.
3756 */
3757 for (i = 0; i < area->nr_pages; i += 1U << page_order) {
3758 unsigned long addr = (unsigned long)page_address(area->pages[i]);
3759
3760 if (addr) {
3761 unsigned long page_size;
3762
3763 page_size = PAGE_SIZE << page_order;
3764 start = min(addr, start);
3765 end = max(addr + page_size, end);
3766 flush_dmap = 1;
3767 }
3768 }
3769
3770 /*
3771 * Set direct map to something invalid so that it won't be cached if
3772 * there are any accesses after the TLB flush, then flush the TLB and
3773 * reset the direct map permissions to the default.
3774 */
3775 set_area_direct_map(area, set_direct_map_invalid_noflush);
3776 _vm_unmap_aliases(start, end, flush_dmap);
3777 set_area_direct_map(area, set_direct_map_default_noflush);
3778}

3783static void delayed_vfree_work(struct work_struct *w)
3784{
3785 struct vfree_deferred *p = container_of(w, struct vfree_deferred, wq);
3786 struct llist_node *t, *llnode;
3787
3788 llist_for_each_safe(llnode, t, llist_del_all(&p->list))
3789 vfree(llnode);
3790}
3791
3802void vfree_atomic(const void *addr)
3803{
3804 struct vfree_deferred *p = raw_cpu_ptr(&vfree_deferred);
3805
3806 BUG_ON(in_nmi());
3807 kmemleak_free(addr);
3808
3809 /*
3810 * Use raw_cpu_ptr() because this can be called from preemptible
3811 * context. Preemption is absolutely fine here, because the llist_add()
3812 * implementation is lockless, so it works even if we are adding to
3813 * another cpu's list. schedule_work() should be fine with this too.
3814 */
3815 if (addr && llist_add((struct llist_node *)addr, &p->list))
3816 schedule_work(&p->wq);
3817}
3818
3839void vfree(const void *addr)
3840{
3841 struct vm_struct *vm;
3842 int i;
3843
3844 if (unlikely(in_interrupt())) {
3845 vfree_atomic(addr);
3846 return;
3847 }
3848
3849 BUG_ON(in_nmi());
3850 kmemleak_free(addr);
3851 might_sleep();
3852
3853 if (!addr)
3854 return;
3855
3856 vm = remove_vm_area(addr);
3857 if (unlikely(!vm)) {
3858 WARN(1, KERN_ERR "Trying to vfree() nonexistent vm area (%p)\n",
3859 addr);
3860 return;
3861 }
3862
3863 if (unlikely(vm->flags & VM_FLUSH_RESET_PERMS))
3864 vm_reset_perms(vm);
3865 /* All pages of vm should be charged to same memcg, so use first one. */
3866 if (vm->nr_pages && !(vm->flags & VM_MAP_PUT_PAGES))
3867 mod_memcg_page_state(vm->pages[0], MEMCG_VMALLOC, -vm->nr_pages);
3868 for (i = 0; i < vm->nr_pages; i++) {
3869 struct page *page = vm->pages[i];
3870
3871 BUG_ON(!page);
3872 /*
3873 * High-order allocs for huge vmallocs are split, so
3874 * can be freed as an array of order-0 allocations
3875 */
3876 __free_page(page);
3877 cond_resched();
3878 }
3879 if (!(vm->flags & VM_MAP_PUT_PAGES))
3880 atomic_long_sub(vm->nr_pages, &nr_vmalloc_pages);
3881 kvfree(vm->pages);
3882 kfree(vm);
3883}
3884EXPORT_SYMBOL(vfree);
3885
3898void vunmap(const void *addr)
3899{
3900 struct vm_struct *vm;
3901
3902 BUG_ON(in_interrupt());
3903 might_sleep();
3904
3905 if (!addr)
3906 return;
3907 vm = remove_vm_area(addr);
3908 if (unlikely(!vm)) {
3909 WARN(1, KERN_ERR "Trying to vunmap() nonexistent vm area (%p)\n",
3910 addr);
3911 return;
3912 }
3913 kfree(vm);
3914}
3915EXPORT_SYMBOL(vunmap);
3916
3935void *vmap(struct page **pages, unsigned int count,
3936 unsigned long flags, pgprot_t prot)
3937{
3938 struct vm_struct *area;
3939 unsigned long addr;
3940 unsigned long size; /* In bytes */
3941
3942 might_sleep();
3943
3944 if (WARN_ON_ONCE(flags & VM_FLUSH_RESET_PERMS))
3945 return NULL;
3946
3947 /*
3948 * Your top guard is someone else's bottom guard. Not having a top
3949 * guard compromises someone else's mappings too.
3950 */
3951 if (WARN_ON_ONCE(flags & VM_NO_GUARD))
3952 flags &= ~VM_NO_GUARD;
3953
3954 if (count > totalram_pages())
3955 return NULL;
3956
3957 size = (unsigned long)count << PAGE_SHIFT;
3958 area = get_vm_area_caller(size, flags, __builtin_return_address(0));
3959 if (!area)
3960 return NULL;
3961
3962 addr = (unsigned long)area->addr;
3963 if (vmap_pages_range(addr, addr + size, pgprot_nx(prot),
3964 pages, PAGE_SHIFT) < 0) {
3965 vunmap(area->addr);
3966 return NULL;
3967 }
3968
3969 if (flags & VM_MAP_PUT_PAGES) {
3970 area->pages = pages;
3971 area->nr_pages = count;
3972 }
3973 return area->addr;
3974}
3975EXPORT_SYMBOL(vmap);

3982struct vmap_pfn_data {
3983 unsigned long *pfns;
3984 pgprot_t prot;
3985 unsigned int idx;
3986};
3987
3991static int vmap_pfn_apply(pte_t *pte, unsigned long addr, void *private)
3992{
3993 struct vmap_pfn_data *data = private;
3994 unsigned long pfn = data->pfns[data->idx];
3995 pte_t ptent;
3996
3997 if (WARN_ON_ONCE(pfn_valid(pfn)))
3998 return -EINVAL;
3999
4000 ptent = pte_mkspecial(pfn_pte(pfn, data->prot));
4001 set_pte_at(&init_mm, addr, pte, ptent);
4002
4003 data->idx++;
4004 return 0;
4005}
4006
4019void *vmap_pfn(unsigned long *pfns, unsigned int count, pgprot_t prot)
4020{
4021 struct vmap_pfn_data data = { .pfns = pfns, .prot = pgprot_nx(prot) };
4022 struct vm_struct *area;
4023
4024 area = get_vm_area_caller(count * PAGE_SIZE, VM_IOREMAP,
4025 __builtin_return_address(0));
4026 if (!area)
4027 return NULL;
4028 if (apply_to_page_range(&init_mm, (unsigned long)area->addr,
4029 count * PAGE_SIZE, vmap_pfn_apply, &data)) {
4030 free_vm_area(area);
4031 return NULL;
4032 }
4033
4034 flush_cache_vmap((unsigned long)area->addr,
4035 (unsigned long)area->addr + count * PAGE_SIZE);
4036
4037 return area->addr;
4038}
4039EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL(vmap_pfn);

4048static inline gfp_t vmalloc_gfp_adjust(gfp_t flags, const bool large)
4049{
4050 flags |= __GFP_NOWARN;
4051 if (large)
4052 flags &= ~__GFP_NOFAIL;
4053 return flags;
4054}
4055
4059static inline unsigned int
4060vm_area_alloc_pages(gfp_t gfp, int nid,
4061 unsigned int order, unsigned int nr_pages, struct page **pages)
4062{
4063 unsigned int nr_allocated = 0;
4064 unsigned int nr_remaining = nr_pages;
4065 unsigned int max_attempt_order = MAX_PAGE_ORDER;
4066 struct page *page;
4067 int i;
4068 unsigned int large_order = ilog2(nr_remaining);
4069 gfp_t large_gfp = vmalloc_gfp_adjust(gfp, large_order) & ~__GFP_DIRECT_RECLAIM;
4070
4071 large_order = min(max_attempt_order, large_order);
4072
4073 /*
4074 * Initially, attempt to have the page allocator give us large order
4075 * pages. Do not attempt allocating smaller than order chunks since
4076 * __vmap_pages_range() expects physically contigous pages of exactly
4077 * order long chunks.
4078 */
4079 while (large_order > order && nr_remaining) {
4080 if (nid == NUMA_NO_NODE)
4081 page = alloc_pages_noprof(large_gfp, large_order);
4082 else
4083 page = alloc_pages_node_noprof(nid, large_gfp, large_order);
4084
4085 if (unlikely(!page)) {
4086 max_attempt_order = --large_order;
4087 continue;
4088 }
4089
4090 split_page(page, large_order);
4091 for (i = 0; i < (1U << large_order); i++)
4092 pages[nr_allocated + i] = page + i;
4093
4094 nr_allocated += 1U << large_order;
4095 nr_remaining = nr_pages - nr_allocated;
4096
4097 large_order = ilog2(nr_remaining);
4098 large_order = min(max_attempt_order, large_order);
4099 }
4100
4101 /*
4102 * For order-0 pages we make use of bulk allocator, if
4103 * the page array is partly or not at all populated due
4104 * to fails, fallback to a single page allocator that is
4105 * more permissive.
4106 */
4107 if (!order) {
4108 while (nr_allocated < nr_pages) {
4109 unsigned int nr, nr_pages_request;
4110
4111 /*
4112 * A maximum allowed request is hard-coded and is 100
4113 * pages per call. That is done in order to prevent a
4114 * long preemption off scenario in the bulk-allocator
4115 * so the range is [1:100].
4116 */
4117 nr_pages_request = min(100U, nr_pages - nr_allocated);
4118
4119 /* memory allocation should consider mempolicy, we can't
4120 * wrongly use nearest node when nid == NUMA_NO_NODE,
4121 * otherwise memory may be allocated in only one node,
4122 * but mempolicy wants to alloc memory by interleaving.
4123 */
4124 if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_NUMA) && nid == NUMA_NO_NODE)
4125 nr = alloc_pages_bulk_mempolicy_noprof(gfp,
4126 nr_pages_request,
4127 pages + nr_allocated);
4128 else
4129 nr = alloc_pages_bulk_node_noprof(gfp, nid,
4130 nr_pages_request,
4131 pages + nr_allocated);
4132
4133 nr_allocated += nr;
4134
4135 /*
4136 * If zero or pages were obtained partly,
4137 * fallback to a single page allocator.
4138 */
4139 if (nr != nr_pages_request)
4140 break;
4141 }
4142 }
4143
4144 /* High-order pages or fallback path if "bulk" fails. */
4145 while (nr_allocated < nr_pages) {
4146 if (!(gfp & __GFP_NOFAIL) && fatal_signal_pending(current))
4147 break;
4148
4149 if (nid == NUMA_NO_NODE)
4150 page = alloc_pages_noprof(gfp, order);
4151 else
4152 page = alloc_pages_node_noprof(nid, gfp, order);
4153
4154 if (unlikely(!page))
4155 break;
4156
4157 /*
4158 * High-order allocations must be able to be treated as
4159 * independent small pages by callers (as they can with
4160 * small-page vmallocs). Some drivers do their own refcounting
4161 * on vmalloc_to_page() pages, some use page->mapping,
4162 * page->lru, etc.
4163 */
4164 if (order)
4165 split_page(page, order);
4166
4167 /*
4168 * Careful, we allocate and map page-order pages, but
4169 * tracking is done per PAGE_SIZE page so as to keep the
4170 * vm_struct APIs independent of the physical/mapped size.
4171 */
4172 for (i = 0; i < (1U << order); i++)
4173 pages[nr_allocated + i] = page + i;
4174
4175 nr_allocated += 1U << order;
4176 }
4177
4178 return nr_allocated;
4179}
4180
4181static LLIST_HEAD(pending_vm_area_cleanup);
4182
4186static void cleanup_vm_area_work(struct work_struct *work)
4187{
4188 struct vm_struct *area, *tmp;
4189 struct llist_node *head;
4190
4191 head = llist_del_all(&pending_vm_area_cleanup);
4192 if (!head)
4193 return;
4194
4195 llist_for_each_entry_safe(area, tmp, head, llnode) {
4196 if (!area->pages)
4197 free_vm_area(area);
4198 else
4199 vfree(area->addr);
4200 }
4201}
4202
4207static DECLARE_WORK(cleanup_vm_area, cleanup_vm_area_work);
4208
4212static void defer_vm_area_cleanup(struct vm_struct *area)
4213{
4214 if (llist_add(&area->llnode, &pending_vm_area_cleanup))
4215 schedule_work(&cleanup_vm_area);
4216}
