4234unsigned int
4235memalloc_apply_gfp_scope(gfp_t gfp_mask)
4236{
4237 unsigned int flags = 0;
4238
4239 if (!gfpflags_allow_blocking(gfp_mask))
4240 flags = memalloc_noreclaim_save();
4241 else if ((gfp_mask & (__GFP_FS | __GFP_IO)) == __GFP_IO)
4242 flags = memalloc_nofs_save();
4243 else if ((gfp_mask & (__GFP_FS | __GFP_IO)) == 0)
4244 flags = memalloc_noio_save();
4245
4246 /* 0 - no scope applied. */
4247 return flags;
4248}
4249
4253void
4254memalloc_restore_scope(unsigned int flags)
4255{
4256 if (flags)
4257 memalloc_flags_restore(flags);
4258}
4259
4263static void *__vmalloc_area_node(struct vm_struct *area, gfp_t gfp_mask,
4264 pgprot_t prot, unsigned int page_shift,
4265 int node)
4266{
4267 const gfp_t nested_gfp = (gfp_mask & GFP_RECLAIM_MASK) | __GFP_ZERO;
4268 bool nofail = gfp_mask & __GFP_NOFAIL;
4269 unsigned long addr = (unsigned long)area->addr;
4270 unsigned long size = get_vm_area_size(area);
4271 unsigned long array_size;
4272 unsigned int nr_small_pages = size >> PAGE_SHIFT;
4273 unsigned int page_order;
4274 unsigned int flags;
4275 int ret;
4276
4277 array_size = (unsigned long)nr_small_pages * sizeof(struct page *);
4278
4279 /* __GFP_NOFAIL and "noblock" flags are mutually exclusive. */
4280 if (!gfpflags_allow_blocking(gfp_mask))
4281 nofail = false;
4282
4283 if (!(gfp_mask & (GFP_DMA | GFP_DMA32)))
4284 gfp_mask |= __GFP_HIGHMEM;
4285
4286 /* Please note that the recursion is strictly bounded. */
4287 if (array_size > PAGE_SIZE) {
4288 area->pages = __vmalloc_node_noprof(array_size, 1, nested_gfp, node,
4289 area->caller);
4290 } else {
4291 area->pages = kmalloc_node_noprof(array_size, nested_gfp, node);
4292 }
4293
4294 if (!area->pages) {
4295 warn_alloc(gfp_mask, NULL,
4296 "vmalloc error: size %lu, failed to allocated page array size %lu",
4297 nr_small_pages * PAGE_SIZE, array_size);
4298 goto fail;
4299 }
4300
4301 set_vm_area_page_order(area, page_shift - PAGE_SHIFT);
4302 page_order = vm_area_page_order(area);
4303
4304 /*
4305 * High-order nofail allocations are really expensive and
4306 * potentially dangerous (pre-mature OOM, disruptive reclaim
4307 * and compaction etc.
4308 *
4309 * Please note, the __vmalloc_node_range_noprof() falls-back
4310 * to order-0 pages if high-order attempt is unsuccessful.
4311 */
4312 area->nr_pages = vm_area_alloc_pages(
4313 vmalloc_gfp_adjust(gfp_mask, page_order), node,
4314 page_order, nr_small_pages, area->pages);
4315
4316 atomic_long_add(area->nr_pages, &nr_vmalloc_pages);
4317 /* All pages of vm should be charged to same memcg, so use first one. */
4318 if (gfp_mask & __GFP_ACCOUNT && area->nr_pages)
4319 mod_memcg_page_state(area->pages[0], MEMCG_VMALLOC,
4320 area->nr_pages);
4321
4322 /*
4323 * If not enough pages were obtained to accomplish an
4324 * allocation request, free them via vfree() if any.
4325 */
4326 if (area->nr_pages != nr_small_pages) {
4327 /*
4328 * vm_area_alloc_pages() can fail due to insufficient memory but
4329 * also:-
4330 *
4331 * - a pending fatal signal
4332 * - insufficient huge page-order pages
4333 *
4334 * Since we always retry allocations at order-0 in the huge page
4335 * case a warning for either is spurious.
4336 */
4337 if (!fatal_signal_pending(current) && page_order == 0)
4338 warn_alloc(gfp_mask, NULL,
4339 "vmalloc error: size %lu, failed to allocate pages",
4340 area->nr_pages * PAGE_SIZE);
4341 goto fail;
4342 }
4343
4344 /*
4345 * page tables allocations ignore external gfp mask, enforce it
4346 * by the scope API
4347 */
4348 flags = memalloc_apply_gfp_scope(gfp_mask);
4349 do {
4350 ret = __vmap_pages_range(addr, addr + size, prot, area->pages,
4351 page_shift, nested_gfp);
4352 if (nofail && (ret < 0))
4353 schedule_timeout_uninterruptible(1);
4354 } while (nofail && (ret < 0));
4355 memalloc_restore_scope(flags);
4356
4357 if (ret < 0) {
4358 warn_alloc(gfp_mask, NULL,
4359 "vmalloc error: size %lu, failed to map pages",
4360 area->nr_pages * PAGE_SIZE);
4361 goto fail;
4362 }
4363
4364 return area->addr;
4365
4366fail:
4367 defer_vm_area_cleanup(area);
4368 return NULL;
4369}
4370
4378#define GFP_VMALLOC_SUPPORTED (GFP_KERNEL | GFP_ATOMIC | GFP_NOWAIT |\
4379 __GFP_NOFAIL | __GFP_ZERO | __GFP_NORETRY |\
4380 GFP_NOFS | GFP_NOIO | GFP_KERNEL_ACCOUNT |\
4381 GFP_USER | __GFP_NOLOCKDEP)
4382
4383
4387static gfp_t vmalloc_fix_flags(gfp_t flags)
4388{
4389 gfp_t invalid_mask = flags & ~GFP_VMALLOC_SUPPORTED;
4390
4391 flags &= GFP_VMALLOC_SUPPORTED;
4392 WARN_ONCE(1, "Unexpected gfp: %#x (%pGg). Fixing up to gfp: %#x (%pGg). Fix your code!\n",
4393 invalid_mask, &invalid_mask, flags, &flags);
4394 return flags;
4395}
4396
4429void *__vmalloc_node_range_noprof(unsigned long size, unsigned long align,
4430 unsigned long start, unsigned long end, gfp_t gfp_mask,
4431 pgprot_t prot, unsigned long vm_flags, int node,
4432 const void *caller)
4433{
4434 struct vm_struct *area;
4435 void *ret;
4436 kasan_vmalloc_flags_t kasan_flags = KASAN_VMALLOC_NONE;
4437 unsigned long original_align = align;
4438 unsigned int shift = PAGE_SHIFT;
4439
4440 if (WARN_ON_ONCE(!size))
4441 return NULL;
4442
4443 if ((size >> PAGE_SHIFT) > totalram_pages()) {
4444 warn_alloc(gfp_mask, NULL,
4445 "vmalloc error: size %lu, exceeds total pages",
4446 size);
4447 return NULL;
4448 }
4449
4450 if (vmap_allow_huge && (vm_flags & VM_ALLOW_HUGE_VMAP)) {
4451 /*
4452 * Try huge pages. Only try for PAGE_KERNEL allocations,
4453 * others like modules don't yet expect huge pages in
4454 * their allocations due to apply_to_page_range not
4455 * supporting them.
4456 */
4457
4458 if (arch_vmap_pmd_supported(prot) && size >= PMD_SIZE)
4459 shift = PMD_SHIFT;
4460 else
4461 shift = arch_vmap_pte_supported_shift(size);
4462
4463 align = max(original_align, 1UL << shift);
4464 }
4465
4466again:
4467 area = __get_vm_area_node(size, align, shift, VM_ALLOC |
4468 VM_UNINITIALIZED | vm_flags, start, end, node,
4469 gfp_mask, caller);
4470 if (!area) {
4471 bool nofail = gfp_mask & __GFP_NOFAIL;
4472 warn_alloc(gfp_mask, NULL,
4473 "vmalloc error: size %lu, vm_struct allocation failed%s",
4474 size, (nofail) ? ". Retrying." : "");
4475 if (nofail) {
4476 schedule_timeout_uninterruptible(1);
4477 goto again;
4478 }
4479 goto fail;
4480 }
4481
4482 /*
4483 * Prepare arguments for __vmalloc_area_node() and
4484 * kasan_unpoison_vmalloc().
4485 */
4486 if (pgprot_val(prot) == pgprot_val(PAGE_KERNEL)) {
4487 if (kasan_hw_tags_enabled()) {
4488 /*
4489 * Modify protection bits to allow tagging.
4490 * This must be done before mapping.
4491 */
4492 prot = arch_vmap_pgprot_tagged(prot);
4493
4494 /*
4495 * Skip page_alloc poisoning and zeroing for physical
4496 * pages backing VM_ALLOC mapping. Memory is instead
4497 * poisoned and zeroed by kasan_unpoison_vmalloc().
4498 */
4499 gfp_mask |= __GFP_SKIP_KASAN | __GFP_SKIP_ZERO;
4500 }
4501
4502 /* Take note that the mapping is PAGE_KERNEL. */
4503 kasan_flags |= KASAN_VMALLOC_PROT_NORMAL;
4504 }
4505
4506 /* Allocate physical pages and map them into vmalloc space. */
4507 ret = __vmalloc_area_node(area, gfp_mask, prot, shift, node);
4508 if (!ret)
4509 goto fail;
4510
4511 /*
4512 * Mark the pages as accessible, now that they are mapped.
4513 * The condition for setting KASAN_VMALLOC_INIT should complement the
4514 * one in post_alloc_hook() with regards to the __GFP_SKIP_ZERO check
4515 * to make sure that memory is initialized under the same conditions.
4516 * Tag-based KASAN modes only assign tags to normal non-executable
4517 * allocations, see __kasan_unpoison_vmalloc().
4518 */
4519 kasan_flags |= KASAN_VMALLOC_VM_ALLOC;
4520 if (!want_init_on_free() && want_init_on_alloc(gfp_mask) &&
4521 (gfp_mask & __GFP_SKIP_ZERO))
4522 kasan_flags |= KASAN_VMALLOC_INIT;
4523 /* KASAN_VMALLOC_PROT_NORMAL already set if required. */
4524 area->addr = kasan_unpoison_vmalloc(area->addr, size, kasan_flags);
4525
4526 /*
4527 * In this function, newly allocated vm_struct has VM_UNINITIALIZED
4528 * flag. It means that vm_struct is not fully initialized.
4529 * Now, it is fully initialized, so remove this flag here.
4530 */
4531 clear_vm_uninitialized_flag(area);
4532
4533 if (!(vm_flags & VM_DEFER_KMEMLEAK))
4534 kmemleak_vmalloc(area, PAGE_ALIGN(size), gfp_mask);
4535
4536 return area->addr;
4537
4538fail:
4539 if (shift > PAGE_SHIFT) {
4540 shift = PAGE_SHIFT;
4541 align = original_align;
4542 goto again;
4543 }
4544
4545 return NULL;
4546}
4547

4569{

4571 gfp_mask, PAGE_KERNEL, 0, node, caller);

4766void *vrealloc_node_align_noprof(const void *p, size_t size, unsigned long align,
4767 gfp_t flags, int nid)
4768{
4769 struct vm_struct *vm = NULL;
4770 size_t alloced_size = 0;
4771 size_t old_size = 0;
4772 void *n;
4773
4774 if (!size) {
4775 vfree(p);
4776 return NULL;
4777 }
4778
4779 if (p) {
4780 vm = find_vm_area(p);
4781 if (unlikely(!vm)) {
4782 WARN(1, "Trying to vrealloc() nonexistent vm area (%p)\n", p);
4783 return NULL;
4784 }
4785
4786 alloced_size = get_vm_area_size(vm);
4787 old_size = vm->requested_size;
4788 if (WARN(alloced_size < old_size,
4789 "vrealloc() has mismatched area vs requested sizes (%p)\n", p))
4790 return NULL;
4791 if (WARN(!IS_ALIGNED((unsigned long)p, align),
4792 "will not reallocate with a bigger alignment (0x%lx)\n", align))
4793 return NULL;
4794 if (unlikely(flags & __GFP_THISNODE) && nid != NUMA_NO_NODE &&
4795 nid != page_to_nid(vmalloc_to_page(p)))
4796 goto need_realloc;
4797 }
4798
4799 /*
4800 * TODO: Shrink the vm_area, i.e. unmap and free unused pages. What
4801 * would be a good heuristic for when to shrink the vm_area?
4802 */
4803 if (size <= old_size) {
4804 /* Zero out "freed" memory, potentially for future realloc. */
4805 if (want_init_on_free() || want_init_on_alloc(flags))
4806 memset((void *)p + size, 0, old_size - size);
4807 vm->requested_size = size;
4808 kasan_vrealloc(p, old_size, size);
4809 return (void *)p;
4810 }
4811
4812 /*
4813 * We already have the bytes available in the allocation; use them.
4814 */
4815 if (size <= alloced_size) {
4816 /*
4817 * No need to zero memory here, as unused memory will have
4818 * already been zeroed at initial allocation time or during
4819 * realloc shrink time.
4820 */
4821 vm->requested_size = size;
4822 kasan_vrealloc(p, old_size, size);
4823 return (void *)p;
4824 }
4825
4826need_realloc:
4827 /* TODO: Grow the vm_area, i.e. allocate and map additional pages. */
4828 n = __vmalloc_node_noprof(size, align, flags, nid, __builtin_return_address(0));
4829
4830 if (!n)
4831 return NULL;
4832
4833 if (p) {
4834 memcpy(n, p, min(size, old_size));
4835 vfree(p);
4836 }
4837
4838 return n;
4839}
4840EXPORT_SYMBOL(vrealloc_node_align_noprof);

4902static size_t zero_iter(struct iov_iter *iter, size_t count)
4903{
4904 size_t remains = count;
4905
4906 while (remains > 0) {
4907 size_t num, copied;
4908
4909 num = min_t(size_t, remains, PAGE_SIZE);
4910 copied = copy_page_to_iter_nofault(ZERO_PAGE(0), 0, num, iter);
4911 remains -= copied;
4912
4913 if (copied < num)
4914 break;
4915 }
4916
4917 return count - remains;
4918}
4919
4929static size_t aligned_vread_iter(struct iov_iter *iter,
4930 const char *addr, size_t count)
4931{
4932 size_t remains = count;
4933 struct page *page;
4934
4935 while (remains > 0) {
4936 unsigned long offset, length;
4937 size_t copied = 0;
4938
4939 offset = offset_in_page(addr);
4940 length = PAGE_SIZE - offset;
4941 if (length > remains)
4942 length = remains;
4943 page = vmalloc_to_page(addr);
4944 /*
4945 * To do safe access to this _mapped_ area, we need lock. But
4946 * adding lock here means that we need to add overhead of
4947 * vmalloc()/vfree() calls for this _debug_ interface, rarely
4948 * used. Instead of that, we'll use an local mapping via
4949 * copy_page_to_iter_nofault() and accept a small overhead in
4950 * this access function.
4951 */
4952 if (page)
4953 copied = copy_page_to_iter_nofault(page, offset,
4954 length, iter);
4955 else
4956 copied = zero_iter(iter, length);
4957
4958 addr += copied;
4959 remains -= copied;
4960
4961 if (copied != length)
4962 break;
4963 }
4964
4965 return count - remains;
4966}
4967
4976static size_t vmap_ram_vread_iter(struct iov_iter *iter, const char *addr,
4977 size_t count, unsigned long flags)
4978{
4979 char *start;
4980 struct vmap_block *vb;
4981 struct xarray *xa;
4982 unsigned long offset;
4983 unsigned int rs, re;
4984 size_t remains, n;
4985
4986 /*
4987 * If it's area created by vm_map_ram() interface directly, but
4988 * not further subdividing and delegating management to vmap_block,
4989 * handle it here.
4990 */
4991 if (!(flags & VMAP_BLOCK))
4992 return aligned_vread_iter(iter, addr, count);
4993
4994 remains = count;
4995
4996 /*
4997 * Area is split into regions and tracked with vmap_block, read out
4998 * each region and zero fill the hole between regions.
4999 */
5000 xa = addr_to_vb_xa((unsigned long) addr);
5001 vb = xa_load(xa, addr_to_vb_idx((unsigned long)addr));
5002 if (!vb)
5003 goto finished_zero;
5004
5005 spin_lock(&vb->lock);
5006 if (bitmap_empty(vb->used_map, VMAP_BBMAP_BITS)) {
5007 spin_unlock(&vb->lock);
5008 goto finished_zero;
5009 }
5010
5011 for_each_set_bitrange(rs, re, vb->used_map, VMAP_BBMAP_BITS) {
5012 size_t copied;
5013
5014 if (remains == 0)
5015 goto finished;
5016
5017 start = vmap_block_vaddr(vb->va->va_start, rs);
5018
5019 if (addr < start) {
5020 size_t to_zero = min_t(size_t, start - addr, remains);
5021 size_t zeroed = zero_iter(iter, to_zero);
5022
5023 addr += zeroed;
5024 remains -= zeroed;
5025
5026 if (remains == 0 || zeroed != to_zero)
5027 goto finished;
5028 }
5029
5030 /*it could start reading from the middle of used region*/
5031 offset = offset_in_page(addr);
5032 n = ((re - rs + 1) << PAGE_SHIFT) - offset;
5033 if (n > remains)
5034 n = remains;
5035
5036 copied = aligned_vread_iter(iter, start + offset, n);
5037
5038 addr += copied;
5039 remains -= copied;
5040
5041 if (copied != n)
5042 goto finished;
5043 }
5044
5045 spin_unlock(&vb->lock);
5046
5047finished_zero:
5048 /* zero-fill the left dirty or free regions */
5049 return count - remains + zero_iter(iter, remains);
5050finished:
5051 /* We couldn't copy/zero everything */
5052 spin_unlock(&vb->lock);
5053 return count - remains;
5054}
5055
5083long vread_iter(struct iov_iter *iter, const char *addr, size_t count)
5084{
5085 struct vmap_node *vn;
5086 struct vmap_area *va;
5087 struct vm_struct *vm;
5088 char *vaddr;
5089 size_t n, size, flags, remains;
5090 unsigned long next;
5091
5092 addr = kasan_reset_tag(addr);
5093
5094 /* Don't allow overflow */
5095 if ((unsigned long) addr + count < count)
5096 count = -(unsigned long) addr;
5097
5098 remains = count;
5099
5100 vn = find_vmap_area_exceed_addr_lock((unsigned long) addr, &va);
5101 if (!vn)
5102 goto finished_zero;
5103
5104 /* no intersects with alive vmap_area */
5105 if ((unsigned long)addr + remains <= va->va_start)
5106 goto finished_zero;
5107
5108 do {
5109 size_t copied;
5110
5111 if (remains == 0)
5112 goto finished;
5113
5114 vm = va->vm;
5115 flags = va->flags & VMAP_FLAGS_MASK;
5116 /*
5117 * VMAP_BLOCK indicates a sub-type of vm_map_ram area, need
5118 * be set together with VMAP_RAM.
5119 */
5120 WARN_ON(flags == VMAP_BLOCK);
5121
5122 if (!vm && !flags)
5123 goto next_va;
5124
5125 if (vm && (vm->flags & VM_UNINITIALIZED))
5126 goto next_va;
5127
5128 /* Pair with smp_wmb() in clear_vm_uninitialized_flag() */
5129 smp_rmb();
5130
5131 vaddr = (char *) va->va_start;
5132 size = vm ? get_vm_area_size(vm) : va_size(va);
5133
5134 if (addr >= vaddr + size)
5135 goto next_va;
5136
5137 if (addr < vaddr) {
5138 size_t to_zero = min_t(size_t, vaddr - addr, remains);
5139 size_t zeroed = zero_iter(iter, to_zero);
5140
5141 addr += zeroed;
5142 remains -= zeroed;
5143
5144 if (remains == 0 || zeroed != to_zero)
5145 goto finished;
5146 }
5147
5148 n = vaddr + size - addr;
5149 if (n > remains)
5150 n = remains;
5151
5152 if (flags & VMAP_RAM)
5153 copied = vmap_ram_vread_iter(iter, addr, n, flags);
5154 else if (!(vm && (vm->flags & (VM_IOREMAP | VM_SPARSE))))
5155 copied = aligned_vread_iter(iter, addr, n);
5156 else /* IOREMAP | SPARSE area is treated as memory hole */
5157 copied = zero_iter(iter, n);
5158
5159 addr += copied;
5160 remains -= copied;
5161
5162 if (copied != n)
5163 goto finished;
5164
5165 next_va:
5166 next = va->va_end;
5167 spin_unlock(&vn->busy.lock);
5168 } while ((vn = find_vmap_area_exceed_addr_lock(next, &va)));
5169
5170finished_zero:
5171 if (vn)
5172 spin_unlock(&vn->busy.lock);
5173
5174 /* zero-fill memory holes */
5175 return count - remains + zero_iter(iter, remains);
5176finished:
5177 /* Nothing remains, or We couldn't copy/zero everything. */
5178 if (vn)
5179 spin_unlock(&vn->busy.lock);
5180
5181 return count - remains;
5182}
5183
5204int remap_vmalloc_range_partial(struct vm_area_struct *vma, unsigned long uaddr,
5205 void *kaddr, unsigned long pgoff,
5206 unsigned long size)
5207{
5208 struct vm_struct *area;
5209 unsigned long off;
5210 unsigned long end_index;
5211
5212 if (check_shl_overflow(pgoff, PAGE_SHIFT, &off))
5213 return -EINVAL;
5214
5215 size = PAGE_ALIGN(size);
5216
5217 if (!PAGE_ALIGNED(uaddr) || !PAGE_ALIGNED(kaddr))
5218 return -EINVAL;
5219
5220 area = find_vm_area(kaddr);
5221 if (!area)
5222 return -EINVAL;
5223
5224 if (!(area->flags & (VM_USERMAP | VM_DMA_COHERENT)))
5225 return -EINVAL;
5226
5227 if (check_add_overflow(size, off, &end_index) ||
5228 end_index > get_vm_area_size(area))
5229 return -EINVAL;
5230 kaddr += off;
5231
5232 do {
5233 struct page *page = vmalloc_to_page(kaddr);
5234 int ret;
5235
5236 ret = vm_insert_page(vma, uaddr, page);
5237 if (ret)
5238 return ret;
5239
5240 uaddr += PAGE_SIZE;
5241 kaddr += PAGE_SIZE;
5242 size -= PAGE_SIZE;
5243 } while (size > 0);
5244
5245 vm_flags_set(vma, VM_DONTEXPAND | VM_DONTDUMP);
5246
5247 return 0;
5248}
5249
5267int remap_vmalloc_range(struct vm_area_struct *vma, void *addr,

5269{
5270 return remap_vmalloc_range_partial(vma, vma->vm_start,
5271 addr, pgoff,
5272 vma->vm_end - vma->vm_start);

5306static struct vmap_area *
5307pvm_find_va_enclose_addr(unsigned long addr)
5308{
5309 struct vmap_area *va, *tmp;
5310 struct rb_node *n;
5311
5312 n = free_vmap_area_root.rb_node;
5313 va = NULL;
5314
5315 while (n) {
5316 tmp = rb_entry(n, struct vmap_area, rb_node);
5317 if (tmp->va_start <= addr) {
5318 va = tmp;
5319 if (tmp->va_end >= addr)
5320 break;
5321
5322 n = n->rb_right;
5323 } else {
5324 n = n->rb_left;
5325 }
5326 }
5327
5328 return va;
5329}
5330
5344static unsigned long
5345pvm_determine_end_from_reverse(struct vmap_area **va, unsigned long align)
5346{
5347 unsigned long vmalloc_end = VMALLOC_END & ~(align - 1);
5348 unsigned long addr;
5349
5350 if (likely(*va)) {
5351 list_for_each_entry_from_reverse((*va),
5352 &free_vmap_area_list, list) {
5353 addr = min((*va)->va_end & ~(align - 1), vmalloc_end);
5354 if ((*va)->va_start < addr)
5355 return addr;
5356 }
5357 }
5358
5359 return 0;
5360}
5361
5389struct vm_struct **pcpu_get_vm_areas(const unsigned long *offsets,
5390 const size_t *sizes, int nr_vms,
5391 size_t align)
5392{
5393 const unsigned long vmalloc_start = ALIGN(VMALLOC_START, align);
5394 const unsigned long vmalloc_end = VMALLOC_END & ~(align - 1);
5395 struct vmap_area **vas, *va;
5396 struct vm_struct **vms;
5397 int area, area2, last_area, term_area;
5398 unsigned long base, start, size, end, last_end, orig_start, orig_end;
5399 bool purged = false;
5400
5401 /* verify parameters and allocate data structures */
5402 BUG_ON(offset_in_page(align) || !is_power_of_2(align));
5403 for (last_area = 0, area = 0; area < nr_vms; area++) {
5404 start = offsets[area];
5405 end = start + sizes[area];
5406
5407 /* is everything aligned properly? */
5408 BUG_ON(!IS_ALIGNED(offsets[area], align));
5409 BUG_ON(!IS_ALIGNED(sizes[area], align));
5410
5411 /* detect the area with the highest address */
5412 if (start > offsets[last_area])
5413 last_area = area;
5414
5415 for (area2 = area + 1; area2 < nr_vms; area2++) {
5416 unsigned long start2 = offsets[area2];
5417 unsigned long end2 = start2 + sizes[area2];
5418
5419 BUG_ON(start2 < end && start < end2);
5420 }
5421 }
5422 last_end = offsets[last_area] + sizes[last_area];
5423
5424 if (vmalloc_end - vmalloc_start < last_end) {
5425 WARN_ON(true);
5426 return NULL;
5427 }
5428
5429 vms = kzalloc_objs(vms[0], nr_vms);
5430 vas = kzalloc_objs(vas[0], nr_vms);
5431 if (!vas || !vms)
5432 goto err_free2;
5433
5434 for (area = 0; area < nr_vms; area++) {
5435 vas[area] = kmem_cache_zalloc(vmap_area_cachep, GFP_KERNEL);
5436 vms[area] = kzalloc_obj(struct vm_struct);
5437 if (!vas[area] || !vms[area])
5438 goto err_free;
5439 }
5440retry:
5441 spin_lock(&free_vmap_area_lock);
5442
5443 /* start scanning - we scan from the top, begin with the last area */
5444 area = term_area = last_area;
5445 start = offsets[area];
5446 end = start + sizes[area];
5447
5448 va = pvm_find_va_enclose_addr(vmalloc_end);
5449 base = pvm_determine_end_from_reverse(&va, align) - end;
5450
5451 while (true) {
5452 /*
5453 * base might have underflowed, add last_end before
5454 * comparing.
5455 */
5456 if (base + last_end < vmalloc_start + last_end)
5457 goto overflow;
5458
5459 /*
5460 * Fitting base has not been found.
5461 */
5462 if (va == NULL)
5463 goto overflow;
5464
5465 /*
5466 * If required width exceeds current VA block, move
5467 * base downwards and then recheck.
5468 */
5469 if (base + end > va->va_end) {
5470 base = pvm_determine_end_from_reverse(&va, align) - end;
5471 term_area = area;
5472 continue;
5473 }
5474
5475 /*
5476 * If this VA does not fit, move base downwards and recheck.
5477 */
5478 if (base + start < va->va_start) {
5479 va = node_to_va(rb_prev(&va->rb_node));
5480 base = pvm_determine_end_from_reverse(&va, align) - end;
5481 term_area = area;
5482 continue;
5483 }
5484
5485 /*
5486 * This area fits, move on to the previous one. If
5487 * the previous one is the terminal one, we're done.
5488 */
5489 area = (area + nr_vms - 1) % nr_vms;
5490 if (area == term_area)
5491 break;
5492
5493 start = offsets[area];
5494 end = start + sizes[area];
5495 va = pvm_find_va_enclose_addr(base + end);
5496 }
5497
5498 /* we've found a fitting base, insert all va's */
5499 for (area = 0; area < nr_vms; area++) {
5500 int ret;
5501
5502 start = base + offsets[area];
5503 size = sizes[area];
5504
5505 va = pvm_find_va_enclose_addr(start);
5506 if (WARN_ON_ONCE(va == NULL))
5507 /* It is a BUG(), but trigger recovery instead. */
5508 goto recovery;
5509
5510 ret = va_clip(&free_vmap_area_root,
5511 &free_vmap_area_list, va, start, size);
5512 if (WARN_ON_ONCE(unlikely(ret)))
5513 /* It is a BUG(), but trigger recovery instead. */
5514 goto recovery;
5515
5516 /* Allocated area. */
5517 va = vas[area];
5518 va->va_start = start;
5519 va->va_end = start + size;
5520 }
5521
5522 spin_unlock(&free_vmap_area_lock);
5523
5524 /* populate the kasan shadow space */
5525 for (area = 0; area < nr_vms; area++) {
5526 if (kasan_populate_vmalloc(vas[area]->va_start, sizes[area], GFP_KERNEL))
5527 goto err_free_shadow;
5528 }
5529
5530 /* insert all vm's */
5531 for (area = 0; area < nr_vms; area++) {
5532 struct vmap_node *vn = addr_to_node(vas[area]->va_start);
5533
5534 spin_lock(&vn->busy.lock);
5535 insert_vmap_area(vas[area], &vn->busy.root, &vn->busy.head);
5536 setup_vmalloc_vm(vms[area], vas[area], VM_ALLOC,
5537 pcpu_get_vm_areas);
5538 spin_unlock(&vn->busy.lock);
5539 }
5540
5541 /*
5542 * Mark allocated areas as accessible. Do it now as a best-effort
5543 * approach, as they can be mapped outside of vmalloc code.
5544 * With hardware tag-based KASAN, marking is skipped for
5545 * non-VM_ALLOC mappings, see __kasan_unpoison_vmalloc().
5546 */
5547 kasan_unpoison_vmap_areas(vms, nr_vms, KASAN_VMALLOC_PROT_NORMAL);
5548
5549 kfree(vas);
5550 return vms;
5551
5552recovery:
5553 /*
5554 * Remove previously allocated areas. There is no
5555 * need in removing these areas from the busy tree,
5556 * because they are inserted only on the final step
5557 * and when pcpu_get_vm_areas() is success.
5558 */
5559 while (area--) {
5560 orig_start = vas[area]->va_start;
5561 orig_end = vas[area]->va_end;
5562 va = merge_or_add_vmap_area_augment(vas[area], &free_vmap_area_root,
5563 &free_vmap_area_list);
5564 if (va)
5565 kasan_release_vmalloc(orig_start, orig_end,
5566 va->va_start, va->va_end,
5567 KASAN_VMALLOC_PAGE_RANGE | KASAN_VMALLOC_TLB_FLUSH);
5568 vas[area] = NULL;
5569 }
5570
5571overflow:
5572 spin_unlock(&free_vmap_area_lock);
5573 if (!purged) {
5574 reclaim_and_purge_vmap_areas();
5575 purged = true;
5576
5577 /* Before "retry", check if we recover. */
5578 for (area = 0; area < nr_vms; area++) {
5579 if (vas[area])
5580 continue;
5581
5582 vas[area] = kmem_cache_zalloc(
5583 vmap_area_cachep, GFP_KERNEL);
5584 if (!vas[area])
5585 goto err_free;
5586 }
5587
5588 goto retry;
5589 }
5590
5591err_free:
5592 for (area = 0; area < nr_vms; area++) {
5593 if (vas[area])
5594 kmem_cache_free(vmap_area_cachep, vas[area]);
5595
5596 kfree(vms[area]);
5597 }
5598err_free2:
5599 kfree(vas);
5600 kfree(vms);
5601 return NULL;
5602
5603err_free_shadow:
5604 spin_lock(&free_vmap_area_lock);
5605 /*
5606 * We release all the vmalloc shadows, even the ones for regions that
5607 * hadn't been successfully added. This relies on kasan_release_vmalloc
5608 * being able to tolerate this case.
5609 */
5610 for (area = 0; area < nr_vms; area++) {
5611 orig_start = vas[area]->va_start;
5612 orig_end = vas[area]->va_end;
5613 va = merge_or_add_vmap_area_augment(vas[area], &free_vmap_area_root,
5614 &free_vmap_area_list);
5615 if (va)
5616 kasan_release_vmalloc(orig_start, orig_end,
5617 va->va_start, va->va_end,
5618 KASAN_VMALLOC_PAGE_RANGE | KASAN_VMALLOC_TLB_FLUSH);
5619 vas[area] = NULL;
5620 kfree(vms[area]);
5621 }
5622 spin_unlock(&free_vmap_area_lock);
5623 kfree(vas);
5624 kfree(vms);
5625 return NULL;
5626}

5653bool vmalloc_dump_obj(void *object)
5654{
5655 const void *caller;
5656 struct vm_struct *vm;
5657 struct vmap_area *va;
5658 struct vmap_node *vn;
5659 unsigned long addr;
5660 unsigned int nr_pages;
5661
5662 addr = PAGE_ALIGN((unsigned long) object);
5663 vn = addr_to_node(addr);
5664
5665 if (!spin_trylock(&vn->busy.lock))
5666 return false;
5667
5668 va = __find_vmap_area(addr, &vn->busy.root);
5669 if (!va || !va->vm) {
5670 spin_unlock(&vn->busy.lock);
5671 return false;
5672 }
5673
5674 vm = va->vm;
5675 addr = (unsigned long) vm->addr;
5676 caller = vm->caller;
5677 nr_pages = vm->nr_pages;
5678 spin_unlock(&vn->busy.lock);
5679
5680 pr_cont(" %u-page vmalloc region starting at %#lx allocated at %pS\n",
5681 nr_pages, addr, caller);
5682
5683 return true;
5684}

5698static void show_numa_info(struct seq_file *m, struct vm_struct *v,
5699 unsigned int *counters)
5700{
5701 unsigned int nr;
5702 unsigned int step = 1U << vm_area_page_order(v);
5703
5704 if (!counters)
5705 return;
5706
5707 memset(counters, 0, nr_node_ids * sizeof(unsigned int));
5708
5709 for (nr = 0; nr < v->nr_pages; nr += step)
5710 counters[page_to_nid(v->pages[nr])] += step;
5711 for_each_node_state(nr, N_HIGH_MEMORY)
5712 if (counters[nr])
5713 seq_printf(m, " N%u=%u", nr, counters[nr]);
5714}
5715
5719static void show_purge_info(struct seq_file *m)
5720{
5721 struct vmap_node *vn;
5722 struct vmap_area *va;
5723
5724 for_each_vmap_node(vn) {
5725 spin_lock(&vn->lazy.lock);
5726 list_for_each_entry(va, &vn->lazy.head, list) {
5727 seq_printf(m, "0x%pK-0x%pK %7ld unpurged vm_area\n",
5728 (void *)va->va_start, (void *)va->va_end,
5729 va_size(va));
5730 }
5731 spin_unlock(&vn->lazy.lock);
5732 }
5733}
5734
5738static int vmalloc_info_show(struct seq_file *m, void *p)
5739{
5740 struct vmap_node *vn;
5741 struct vmap_area *va;
5742 struct vm_struct *v;
5743 unsigned int *counters;
5744
5745 if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_NUMA))
5746 counters = kmalloc_array(nr_node_ids, sizeof(unsigned int), GFP_KERNEL);
5747
5748 for_each_vmap_node(vn) {
5749 spin_lock(&vn->busy.lock);
5750 list_for_each_entry(va, &vn->busy.head, list) {
5751 if (!va->vm) {
5752 if (va->flags & VMAP_RAM)
5753 seq_printf(m, "0x%pK-0x%pK %7ld vm_map_ram\n",
5754 (void *)va->va_start, (void *)va->va_end,
5755 va_size(va));
5756
5757 continue;
5758 }
5759
5760 v = va->vm;
5761 if (v->flags & VM_UNINITIALIZED)
5762 continue;
5763
5764 /* Pair with smp_wmb() in clear_vm_uninitialized_flag() */
5765 smp_rmb();
5766
5767 seq_printf(m, "0x%pK-0x%pK %7ld",
5768 v->addr, v->addr + v->size, v->size);
5769
5770 if (v->caller)
5771 seq_printf(m, " %pS", v->caller);
5772
5773 if (v->nr_pages)
5774 seq_printf(m, " pages=%d", v->nr_pages);
5775
5776 if (v->phys_addr)
5777 seq_printf(m, " phys=%pa", &v->phys_addr);
5778
5779 if (v->flags & VM_IOREMAP)
5780 seq_puts(m, " ioremap");
5781
5782 if (v->flags & VM_SPARSE)
5783 seq_puts(m, " sparse");
5784
5785 if (v->flags & VM_ALLOC)
5786 seq_puts(m, " vmalloc");
5787
5788 if (v->flags & VM_MAP)
5789 seq_puts(m, " vmap");
5790
5791 if (v->flags & VM_USERMAP)
5792 seq_puts(m, " user");
5793
5794 if (v->flags & VM_DMA_COHERENT)
5795 seq_puts(m, " dma-coherent");
5796
5797 if (is_vmalloc_addr(v->pages))
5798 seq_puts(m, " vpages");
5799
5800 if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_NUMA))
5801 show_numa_info(m, v, counters);
5802
5803 seq_putc(m, '\n');
5804 }
5805 spin_unlock(&vn->busy.lock);
5806 }
5807
5808 /*
5809 * As a final step, dump "unpurged" areas.
5810 */
5811 show_purge_info(m);
5812 if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_NUMA))
5813 kfree(counters);
5814 return 0;
5815}

5824}
5825module_init(proc_vmalloc_init);

5832static void __init vmap_init_free_space(void)
5833{
5834 unsigned long vmap_start = 1;
5835 const unsigned long vmap_end = ULONG_MAX;
5836 struct vmap_area *free;
5837 struct vm_struct *busy;
5838
5839 /*
5840 * B F B B B F
5841 * -|-----|.....|-----|-----|-----|.....|-
5842 * | The KVA space |
5843 * |<--------------------------------->|
5844 */
5845 for (busy = vmlist; busy; busy = busy->next) {
5846 if ((unsigned long) busy->addr - vmap_start > 0) {
5847 free = kmem_cache_zalloc(vmap_area_cachep, GFP_NOWAIT);
5848 if (!WARN_ON_ONCE(!free)) {
5849 free->va_start = vmap_start;
5850 free->va_end = (unsigned long) busy->addr;
5851
5852 insert_vmap_area_augment(free, NULL,
5853 &free_vmap_area_root,
5854 &free_vmap_area_list);
5855 }
5856 }
5857
5858 vmap_start = (unsigned long) busy->addr + busy->size;
5859 }
5860
5861 if (vmap_end - vmap_start > 0) {
5862 free = kmem_cache_zalloc(vmap_area_cachep, GFP_NOWAIT);
5863 if (!WARN_ON_ONCE(!free)) {
5864 free->va_start = vmap_start;
5865 free->va_end = vmap_end;
5866
5867 insert_vmap_area_augment(free, NULL,
5868 &free_vmap_area_root,
5869 &free_vmap_area_list);
5870 }
5871 }
5872}
5873
5877static void vmap_init_nodes(void)
5878{
5879 struct vmap_node *vn;
5880 int i;
5881
5882#if BITS_PER_LONG == 64
5883 /*
5884 * A high threshold of max nodes is fixed and bound to 128,
5885 * thus a scale factor is 1 for systems where number of cores
5886 * are less or equal to specified threshold.
5887 *
5888 * As for NUMA-aware notes. For bigger systems, for example
5889 * NUMA with multi-sockets, where we can end-up with thousands
5890 * of cores in total, a "sub-numa-clustering" should be added.
5891 *
5892 * In this case a NUMA domain is considered as a single entity
5893 * with dedicated sub-nodes in it which describe one group or
5894 * set of cores. Therefore a per-domain purging is supposed to
5895 * be added as well as a per-domain balancing.
5896 */
5897 int n = clamp_t(unsigned int, num_possible_cpus(), 1, 128);
5898
5899 if (n > 1) {
5900 vn = kmalloc_objs(*vn, n, GFP_NOWAIT);
5901 if (vn) {
5902 /* Node partition is 16 pages. */
5903 vmap_zone_size = (1 << 4) * PAGE_SIZE;
5904 nr_vmap_nodes = n;
5905 vmap_nodes = vn;
5906 } else {
5907 pr_err("Failed to allocate an array. Disable a node layer\n");
5908 }
5909 }
5910#endif
5911
5912 for_each_vmap_node(vn) {
5913 vn->busy.root = RB_ROOT;
5914 INIT_LIST_HEAD(&vn->busy.head);
5915 spin_lock_init(&vn->busy.lock);
5916
5917 vn->lazy.root = RB_ROOT;
5918 INIT_LIST_HEAD(&vn->lazy.head);
5919 spin_lock_init(&vn->lazy.lock);
5920
5921 for (i = 0; i < MAX_VA_SIZE_PAGES; i++) {
5922 INIT_LIST_HEAD(&vn->pool[i].head);
5923 WRITE_ONCE(vn->pool[i].len, 0);
5924 }
5925
5926 spin_lock_init(&vn->pool_lock);
5927 }
5928}
5929
5933static unsigned long
5934vmap_node_shrink_count(struct shrinker *shrink, struct shrink_control *sc)
5935{
5936 unsigned long count = 0;
5937 struct vmap_node *vn;
5938 int i;
5939
5940 for_each_vmap_node(vn) {
5941 for (i = 0; i < MAX_VA_SIZE_PAGES; i++)
5942 count += READ_ONCE(vn->pool[i].len);
5943 }
5944
5945 return count ? count : SHRINK_EMPTY;
5946}
5947
5951static unsigned long
5952vmap_node_shrink_scan(struct shrinker *shrink, struct shrink_control *sc)
5953{
5954 struct vmap_node *vn;
5955
5956 guard(mutex)(&vmap_purge_lock);
5957 for_each_vmap_node(vn)
5958 decay_va_pool_node(vn, true);
5959
5960 return SHRINK_STOP;
5961}

5966void __init vmalloc_init(void)
5967{
5968 struct shrinker *vmap_node_shrinker;
5969 struct vmap_area *va;
5970 struct vmap_node *vn;
5971 struct vm_struct *tmp;
5972 int i;
5973
5974 /*
5975 * Create the cache for vmap_area objects.
5976 */
5977 vmap_area_cachep = KMEM_CACHE(vmap_area, SLAB_PANIC);
5978
5979 for_each_possible_cpu(i) {
5980 struct vmap_block_queue *vbq;
5981 struct vfree_deferred *p;
5982
5983 vbq = &per_cpu(vmap_block_queue, i);
5984 spin_lock_init(&vbq->lock);
5985 INIT_LIST_HEAD(&vbq->free);
5986 p = &per_cpu(vfree_deferred, i);
5987 init_llist_head(&p->list);
5988 INIT_WORK(&p->wq, delayed_vfree_work);
5989 xa_init(&vbq->vmap_blocks);
5990 }
5991
5992 /*
5993 * Setup nodes before importing vmlist.
5994 */
5995 vmap_init_nodes();
5996
5997 /* Import existing vmlist entries. */
5998 for (tmp = vmlist; tmp; tmp = tmp->next) {
5999 va = kmem_cache_zalloc(vmap_area_cachep, GFP_NOWAIT);
6000 if (WARN_ON_ONCE(!va))
6001 continue;
6002
6003 va->va_start = (unsigned long)tmp->addr;
6004 va->va_end = va->va_start + tmp->size;
6005 va->vm = tmp;
6006
6007 vn = addr_to_node(va->va_start);
6008 insert_vmap_area(va, &vn->busy.root, &vn->busy.head);
6009 }
6010
6011 /*
6012 * Now we can initialize a free vmap space.
6013 */
6014 vmap_init_free_space();
6015 vmap_initialized = true;
6016
6017 vmap_node_shrinker = shrinker_alloc(0, "vmap-node");
6018 if (!vmap_node_shrinker) {
6019 pr_err("Failed to allocate vmap-node shrinker!\n");
6020 return;
6021 }
6022
6023 vmap_node_shrinker->count_objects = vmap_node_shrink_count;
6024 vmap_node_shrinker->scan_objects = vmap_node_shrink_scan;
6025 shrinker_register(vmap_node_shrinker);
6026}
